We MUST stop this bill in the Senate and more like it but we need to unite and fight now, before opponents of voting rights in Congress start checking voter suppression bills off their to-do list.
RUSH $25 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [https://secure.everyaction.com/pdjfDAEu4UCpXPQPEnrW-A2]

CBS: Experts warn the proposed SAVE Act could make it harder for some married women to vote. Here's who could be affected. [https://secure.everyaction.com/pdjfDAEu4UCpXPQPEnrW-A2?am=20.00&contactdata=RliQVVejByxea7AJuZN+ZtjF1seVsPeu8yNz1wLmpdkiBdjy3+QnlgfgNNDq7f0Sv078Fq/Vl7p0cHDGVI4wWjfv9CztyB7PvwhozkJB3LU=]
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: The President ordered military strikes on Iran. Congress didn’t authorize it.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250623-1389-foote&t=1001&akid=1389%2E342411%2EkKLdqg ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

The President ordered military strikes on Iran — with zero authorization
from Congress. No debate. No vote. No accountability.

This isn’t just reckless. It’s a dangerous abuse of power. It’s illegal
and a violation of the War Powers Resolution. And it’s exactly how
generations of endless war begin.

We’ve seen what happens when presidents bypass Congress to wage war in the
past: Thousands of lives lost, entire regions destabilized, and trillions
of dollars wasted. And each time, it’s the working class that pays the
price.

Let’s be clear: No president — Democrat or Republican — has the right to
drag this country into war on a whim. And if Congress doesn’t assert its
power now, we may never get it back.

That’s why the Squad Victory Fund is organizing to elect progressives who
will say what too many others won’t — and who will fight in Congress to
rein in presidential war powers and demand real accountability.

Today, we’re calling on Congress and the people to take a stand and speak
up.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/svfem20250623/?source=em20250623-1389&t=1002&akid=1389%2E342411%2EkKLdqg ]Will you add your name here to say: NO NEW WARS.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/svfem20250623/?source=em20250623-1389&t=1003&akid=1389%2E342411%2EkKLdqg ]ADD YOUR NAME: NO NEW WARS

We won’t back down. We’re building a movement, and we’re proud to have you
in it.

In solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

subject: June 23 Campaign Update
body:
Here Is An Update From Our Campaign

| | | | | [|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=1ee06e4af3&e=e907534017)
| | | | | **June 23, 2025**
---
| Here’s an update from our campaign:
---
| | | | | On Monday, while traveling across the district, I stopped by and joined [**WCLO radio**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=cdec673716&e=e907534017)**** in their studio. We discussed the tough issues facing us and the work I am doing in Congress to move our nation forward.
This includes voting for strong government reforms that reduce waste, fraud, and abuse like:
* Instituting work requirements for able-bodied, childless adults to receive Medicaid.
* Requiring citizenship verification for taxpayer-funded programs.
* Eliminating duplicative payments that have cost the federal government billions of dollars.

---
| [Listen Here](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=10e7d2b0a7&e=e907534017)
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=ed0a914cdd&e=e907534017)
|
# Stopping Illegal Immigration
---
| [**News broke**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=36e78c2ed6&e=e907534017) last week that Border Agents did not release a single illegal immigrant into the United States for the month of May. This is down more than [**60,000**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=26c2cf7008&e=e907534017)**** compared to May 2024 under the Biden Administration.
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=65d59337b8&e=e907534017)
| Thanks in part to executive actions of President Trump, fewer illegal immigrants are attempting to cross our border. In May, Border Patrol agents were able to stop [**8,725**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=f92f606dd5&e=e907534017) illegal immigrants from attempting to cross the southern border. This is a 93% decrease from the [**117,000**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=a5c23e4e2e&e=e907534017)**** encounters in 2024.
---
|
---
| In Congress, I am working to help codify President Trump’s executive actions stopping the illegal immigration, human trafficking, and fentanyl crises stemming from our southern border. This includes voting for:
* [$46 billion](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=a5254b6b40&e=e907534017) to help build the wall.
* [$4 billion](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=0e63a3598d&e=e907534017) to hire 8,000 new customs and border agents.

---
|
# Join Our Team
Summer is in full swing and we’d love to have you join our team and help get out our message.
One of the easiest ways to get involved is to [**join us**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=898d8caaa3&e=e907534017) in parades. We will have plenty of opportunities throughout the district this summer, especially on the 4th of July.
---
|
---
| [**Sign up here**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=bcdc30be12&e=e907534017) , bring your family and friends, and join us in celebrating our nation!
---
| **On Wisconsin,** Bryan Steil

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Justice Department Files Statement of Interest in Judicial Watch’s Lawsuit to Compel Oregon to Clean Voter Rolls
body:
Judicial Watch announced that the U.S. Department of Justice filed a statement of interest in Judicial Watch’s lawsuit that calls on Oregon’s secretary of state to make “a reasonable effort to remove” the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls as required by federal law (Judicial Watch, et al. v. The State of Oregon et al. (No. 6:24-cv-01783)). U.S. District Court Judge Michael J. McShane set a hearing in the case for June 18 at 10:00 a.m.

name: Marlin
subject: I raise the finest cows this side of the Mississippi
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stutzman for Congress
body:
I bet that's not what you were expecting on a big red hat these days.

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3td2u6me6i5sovncgl1hv97lvc95rv3b1vs8hl0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) [ MMGA: Make Meat Great Again! ](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2za7nms4nfcdomng27nb6oolj5v19iol0b9vc0mb8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) Hi. I bet that's not what you were expecting on a big red hat these days. (But don't you worry, I'm about as pro-Trump as they come!) My name's Marlin Stutzman. I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House. I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember. Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars. **I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade.** That's how they can sleep at night knowing...
* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers that be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling. _And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._ [That's why I'm left with no choice but to ask you for a small donation today to keep me in Congress. I don't care if it's $3 or $300 - the amount doesn't matter nearly as much as the number of people who give.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zoevv942d28jt2lae4hmr606ophtm3ad153mmik8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) [ DONATE $3 HERE ](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zd95jc868iqtep85pdnnfmuo1ircicqptmkqrq90_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) [ DONATE $30 HERE ](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zm63g57drglsrdo4d29ol7bi6bimg5qsog3pmfvo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) [ DONATE $300 HERE ](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zomkrjvspcct9romag2gv8vgjdme3vi4rvhmu7m8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6cph2bs) So, can I count on you to pitch in? Either way, God bless you! -Marlin | | Paid for by Stutzman for Congress

subject: Participate in our national CRT Survey
body:
There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Updates for Great Americans is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z93s26dkpcte47tee55iogqa3p6k8dev17hedl5g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj1cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2znosle2o2suoc4su3tddiele2qnc45k3t1ke80mo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj1cph2bs)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3n2dr1uq4mhekiiehr6db59bofufnv25nlc9c48_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj1cph2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Now Available: “Ancient Christianity”on DVD
body:
These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdr9c5jckkmj4n6jfj7t7m70i15o3g2pgv2r7ur0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdkv9osu7ogsnrto6lie7b7aib2a698tkuds4vr8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6c5h2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z87661qfst2v3acdoin59dlo5hrg9mv3d7ko6ls8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0ctim9oj6c5h2bs)

Thank you for your support in reaching millions of Americans with the story of the courage and faith of the first Christians.

Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

Hillsdale College

## Trump Declares Iran Ceasefire Plan
President Trump announced Monday evening on Truth Social that Iran and Israel had [agreed to a ceasefire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAQRk-DOyI8GDsuKLahy7ZbWhMYYlYYEJBEuf0v5wp_N9JIT997_27bDUMM6fEXD9Ld5y3Ru0XqnerW6_MolrCRD5UcUWkFLZV9AwGKi5nDtDkM8bNNg9OeCEgOpMdFiUWtSl6HXbvReWXVQuO4qutMd2Hn--hBrGLydpRD0CdNzDCNQii5XBD9TLBcV5LkJFg2CXKh53r5n0PqO_n4yS-qF5uPIeq999KY_MPAMDDpU3Lr54uBOcEMjJjPWzIwz8ZPPwbm68YxpfxMlhoPrSJFjsnxUDHxHV_E8VGJHO-ZfyvwMwMDM1TtyjvEGNq8sEk8Dgzxu6b_KuFLw08AAAD__-zwhPU) for 12 hours, "at which point the War will be considered, ENDED!" Neither country immediately confirmed the ceasefire, but analysts said it offered [both nations an off-ramp](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MHO2yAQBOCnsW9EZLGxc-DQi29_rz1aW1iSrTAg2MTK21dppb5AzzMajb4fX_sXcuJ8_44HOYllz3T2RCLUdmnPo3rCTpEbBaLaK3qqjx00zEpbBdMekNN7n8bgIhGQGcldl1kv82026_hwhKAN2jhNxsfF2Ou6WlgRzG21Wkc9svusaQvTVevZLBfEaAmW9UaGggE_TJoCS2mXX4WzPCimd3lRu_hyjMk9RGofzLcBtgG28zwvwgf1Erk3pPRpDbAlftHPVO47ZWnvAba_KatO_tlY3qrEyJ4xdRVTQVGlCpesSlTPrgL5hI2CemZOKNQwqX8yirPihlk1qqXJANvYXKgnp8TdLsOk7wfynyej_Bfyy8HvAAAA__8ucJV3) to halt the ongoing missile attacks. Earlier Monday, Iran launched 19 missiles at the [American Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3SAQhJ_G7jjCgP8KijTubtqU1hrWxxthQLA-1n37yJHyBOlGM9Jo5vv1tX4BBYrvn3Ci5T2tEe8akBnLyuU6s0OouFNBj5hrBof5WJVUvZCDUGb1QOF7Na23O6JC3aLtxl6O_dzrqT3sMPXbbPQ87zjobesnNW07dN4bKXHuXEv2aZODMp2UvR5fAPuAapxm1Oi1co2R6IlTef1OFPnAPXynD5aXS2cb7MGca6N_NGpp1HLf9ytu7nnx5I-TSvCNWk7yPqBAqNyoJdAHxRbS-5--sgfGKqhAFJyy8JRDOoHFichV5IspiquKrYDDKgoyBAKmFEVxEVRnjJraYn2-KQSqw9gY-T6Bwt-h_F90P1b9CQAA__-j2ZGA) in response to U.S. airstrikes, but 18 were intercepted and one landed harmlessly. Trump said the U.S. had advance warning of the attack. After the Qatar attack, oil prices fell, [dropping below $70 a barrel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGq2zAURL9G3iko13Kct_AipZhCed100aW5kcbxbWTLleSY_H1xf6GrgRkYDufX5_DJEmR5_OAZXRnjsGDPAaUgDSVt8-rAGaMkeGDNKzus00CGGm0umuzgWcJ7sJXvRoBQV-jObWPa5qOpr9XUGetAuDNZjFd2jR-v1rnGkLn75my5ku54MxeyZ2Oauj0xjxdQe_1ADV-TU9bAS4np9DvKUiaM4R1fSCcX5yp0UylrVvVNUa-o3_f9NOfl2BT1WPSWFfVzXPA-ktMT5WiiBL0mcci6bPM9QHPWknjRXAq7p-ZXFJ-1S5uHlmVMnEvaXNkSFPWc9O12_vb4_mdTdR-deFV__XJ4xJ5_Iq1V6vy6SwiSL62y5jGzhH_E5b80vzr6GwAA__8x85TC), as fears of broader disruption faded.
## World's Largest Telescope Unveils Its First Photos
The Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile released its first images Monday, [revealing colorful, high-resolution views](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GOwwiqFtQXGO3115pfmVULigGWL19-4v3CtdNMslkvu_rOTzJebcvn7TB5DkMO67kkTPikONrOyZQwuwiLHCkgyYc6yCF1Fw0XKrBkvPvQRXWzIBEXcBUrRatfui6K1YjRk0PVCSEnsfJqkpRq6jpGqvRCUWFM_eaaKSqhNB1WxLNDWTbPVDD1nJiSsC6HGL5HdyeV8z-HU7Ecgpb4c2a85FY_cFkz2R_XVc5jemmuHsm-zsy2XuKC1LmGR5pCgf47GLK3G20IPGFPP04JH4iEo-v0e08jAnxpBzim8m-iMYel_PepaZlSiwbOf_3If9L3GnkbwAAAP__JvqFVw) of the Trifid and Lagoon nebulas and the Virgo galaxy cluster. Built over two decades and home to the world's largest digital camera, [the U.S.-funded telescope](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAUBODT4C4WeYAdCoq_cZe_3RI9wyPGwgFhNk5uv_JeYbuRRvqkma-7vWNM8fn4jxuZFrJ90rEnao2qbfV7K45wpxAreaKyF3RUFgsc1IUPF5DWY0wfKztvAhGQ6MhcR8VHpZW4dYsh9J4GDlrPOHMPImjl3U1KJaVGx7toTo0PIK-cKzH2iGEgGG-aBHkBjklOPrZc-zXHZ1sopE9-Ue1d3rpkltbKzsQ_BhOD6TiOfp7d2TGYzjEMJqwtukRndKuo27o-3sM7d9X4csSU4j6MTPLHhjH9qu1PV7wM_AQAAP__QvJzYw) will scan the southern sky every night for 10 years. In just 10 hours, it detected 2,104 new asteroids, including seven near-Earth objects, and aims to capture 20 billion galaxies while probing dark matter and dark energy. See the [photos in high resolution with annotations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQheGngW5WXhvDUlCk2e6mTYkGewBHxkaeAcLbR3df4dZHOvr0__kavzDEkJbfuNEgcx4TXRxJhMoo5dh2R8g0h0KeaOcdHe3rqJW2oFrQzegxxHtsaj_MRJpMTcOzs6qzvTWveh2muW8tNS9jPLbW6rnvsHfOvBqraMJnHYbvN9Xq5qmUNd0DcW5Jd6-eDHmjXdUo8kFyefzNIclKc7zzSeXh8lbHYRXZuTK_Kv2u9Pu6rsdH-b1W-o0sJae83ZV-n1QQHJRjCgnyxFROlFxuKHQSRoYnC7AcKYW0QNhwIYY8g6wELvOWGdgFShJYGLAQTHTn5IH-uSDkAad8CFwrCoPLW0hLXQa_XyHGwG1XNWrZMMQPXH5U-xz0_wAAAP__TEyZtg).
## Bezos' Italian Wedding Sparks Protests
Protests in Venice have prompted a [venue change for Amazon billionaire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQAL8Gd7bwYsxLQXGNu3ftldYalmciDBZsYiVff8r9wtUjjUbz53v9xphi_vmNB1kOZc10tUTMVFeuj-N0hI1CrOSJznaio3NfQYLu5dzDtHqM6bVOnbeBCEh1ZEejpdE3rb663c7GqU2HoCGoMMrRoPJGjtrPDjezYRftxyZnmEYptTIDYpgJzNeNFHkFTkySfORSh3uJmXcK6VWeVAdXji7ZnflsQv0SsAhYrusaXriX8qECFspMlTHmgzILWLBydImagOVOIfQbvUvrEz4q5b5hdju9W8-UWyy5H_UEMN8Ahp2P1FXrzyumFNtsxCR_DozpXwX_17qnhb8BAAD__7VhhJs) Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez's three-day wedding, scheduled to start today. Activists, including Greenpeace, unfurled banners across the city reading "No Space for Bezos" and "Pay More Tax," while some groups plan to block canals. [See the banner here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAURE9jMrfcH4OnA4JNyGbTDdEHl8Ejgy3b0z306VfsFTYrqaSnqvfnc_pkH_yx_uYdQ3VxOvAqAbUiTzV_72kBFzifYYFUEi9I20SKOql6SXqy7MM56cYODiC0DYa76ZTpHl370WwDacXGsNP9ou-GVaetbu_0eNhZm3nWjR8umupJ35XqWnNjdj3IfDzQwra0CK1gfY359hX9UTe4cMYn8m2JexOGrdZURPtL0ChoTLyi-J-rEzReZEGj6q_cChoXBMzZ11NePwWNX3BOznjHIi12PiysrFEmPuUeM2TlHxQ5n_KJwy-QKceKUpGL5A1sZXQy8HfGIQsfy4a3fMFaf6yCxiYPNr18CL70Rmi17uzDv9n1v1w_B_obAAD__3UolF8). Originally set at the Scuola Grande della Misericordia, at least one event has been moved to the Arsenale area for security. Despite backlash, Bezos has donated roughly [$1.1 million to lagoon restoration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAUBNCvwR0RwdhOCopt3L1tt7SuYbB5woCAJJt8_cr7C6-70pWOZubP1_JFPvi4_aYDurm0RLxqQGsoSyuPIxtQhfMFFsg1k0HeFynkwMXIpVos-fBeVGe1AyT6Dvo6DWIa7kN_63YtzO3aq-mKwZpxvU_rSrhBjMJMSlGvOq9PTYxSXYUY-ulC5EbI6XZHD9tLw5SA9S2Vy3fyse1w4Z2eKBeTji7ovbVcWf-LyZnJOdOG6v-ePybnU2ZyFuN5SyZng4C1-PbmZ08m5284x1d8UuUULQ_0KIi8UjQ7PpW_YK2PG8-BYkSp3MIhWm7SIwdwOrzlT0RvwHNJDbWdaFe0zS8fgq_jxJTYDvLhf9z2o42fWv4LAAD__3ihkhs) and is sourcing most supplies locally. The city's mayor expects the wedding to generate multi-millions in economic activity.

## Abbott Vetoes THC Ban
Less than an hour before a midnight deadline on Sunday, Gov. Greg Abbott vetoed legislation that would have [banned consumable hemp products](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbHOnDAQhJ_GdD7Zi88cBUUauj9tSrS2F3Bi8Mneg__ePuLyCOlGmtEnfZpfX9MXxhT35SduNPD3nKedzpqImcqEzmXmgzhT5dU73Kn4zLVOoOAulZVgpoAxvSfThMGp0OuGBt3dVWfh0atmHYKj0AIGN2sbvG2Vt6EHQuP13N8JmjhcMGXBaK00PG5GgVXdIzjvZ4O6FUZRiJzLjVdi-sY6p3c-qNx83po0rMzPKtofAkYB43metz_Hi65SwIiFo08kYLy8BIzPnCJHf8UPSyZaYk3Ir3KtlkKL_OctK-3IJF1MSbbS572-NnSJJK9eblji7xfuKBOe8oMSMILtZXDKgAYv3R07aUI7y95hkLMLHbRgnJ_bpgzhecaUYrWdMGrZMKaPD__fC8cAfwMAAP__gIedrw) containing the psychoactive compound THC, ending weeks of speculation about what he would do. -It all started in a garage with no budget and a dream.

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

Friend,

I have to tell you what happened when Riley Gaines and I visited San
Francisco State University this Spring on the American Comeback
Tour...

I wish you had been there to see it.

Another packed campus quad. Students eager to listen. Flags waving.
Cheers for America. Energy you could feel in your bones.

_Not in Texas... Not in Florida..._ _CALIFORNIA._

The “Deep Blue” stronghold the Left said we’d never touch.

But we did. And of all places, _in San Francisco..._

At the very same campus where radical Leftists and trans extremists
held Riley hostage for hours just a few short years ago.

We stood on the same ground where they tried to silence her... where
they thought they’d won... and sent the Left a message: YOU FAILED.

And now? We’ll keep pushing. BECAUSE OF PATRIOTS LIKE YOU.

[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

As I stood there looking out at the crowd — hundreds of young
patriots rising up in a place the Left said they owned — I
couldn’t help but think...

13 YEARS AGO, ALL OF THIS FELT... _IMPOSSIBLE._

Back then, Turning Point USA wasn’t the cultural phenomenon it is
today.

It wasn’t an office. It wasn’t a team. _It was just me._

No money. No connections. Just a desk and an old computer in a dusty
garage in the Chicago suburbs.

_But what I did have was a vision..._

It was 2012. The Left controlled every classroom, every campus, and
nearly every corner of our culture.

Their narrative was everywhere: America was evil... Faith was
“oppressive”... Freedom was outdated... The Conservative movement
was dead...

_And most of all, young people belonged to the Left._

I DIDN’T BELIEVE THAT. I COULDN’T ACCEPT THAT. I COULDN’T JUST
STAND BY AND WATCH THE LEFT WIN.

Back then, it was no wonder WHY we were losing young people to the
Left...

The Conservative movement felt stale... Conservative organizations
felt like a snooze... And it felt like no one had an idea of how to
reach America’s youth...

I believed if we were ever going to win young people back for America,
we needed excitement. Energy. Passion. And ZEAL for our ideas.

MY DREAM WAS TO LAUNCH A CONSERVATIVE YOUTH MOVEMENT THAT WOULD
INSPIRE YOUNG PEOPLE TO STAND FOR TRUTH — AND LOVE THIS COUNTRY
AGAIN.

I didn’t know what I was going to call this dream... this feeling...
this movement.

So, I picked up the phone, called my dad, and said, “I think I’m
supposed to start something, but I don’t have a name for it...”

HE REPLIED... _"HOW ABOUT TURNING POINT?"_

And just like that, a fire was lit. Turning Point USA was born. On the
promise that we could TURN this country around, one young heart at a
time.

The early days were brutal.

I remember driving across the Chicago suburbs to small Tea Party
meetings talking about “generational theft”...

I remember my first Turning Point USA speaking event in Peoria,
Illinois during the summer of 2012, where just six people showed up...

AND I REMEMBER THE LOOK IN THEIR EYES — THOSE EARLY PATRIOTS
— WHEN I TOLD THEM THE VISION:

_“We’re going to create a youth movement that LOVES America.” _

_“We’re going to go on campus and win hearts and minds.” _

_“We’re going to push back — and we’re going to WIN.”_

They didn’t laugh... They didn’t walk out...

THEY BELIEVED. AND FRIEND — SO DID PATRIOTS LIKE YOU.

You see, this isn’t my story. This is YOUR story.

Because without patriots like you... _there is no Turning Point USA._

Without you... _there is no American Comeback story._

Without you... _there is no cultural shift happening right now in
schools, churches, homes, and on every campus across our great
nation._

You were there when the campus quads and halls were empty... stood by
us when our signs got torn down.

You had our backs when the mob showed up — when they shouted,
screamed, and tried to wipe us off the map.

YOU DIDN’T GIVE UP. AND NEITHER DID WE.

But we were never supposed to be winning...

The Left thought they owned this generation. They thought their
indoctrination had worked. _But they were wrong._

I remember standing at tables on hostile campuses with nothing but
flyers and hope, praying to have a conversation that would light a
spark.

I went where I was told a young conservative didn’t belong. And I
kept going back.

[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

AND THEN... SOMETHING HAPPENED... _THE STUDENTS STARTED LISTENING._

They started to question everything, think for themselves, and no
longer be afraid to stand up.

Then, they started showing up. _In DROVES._

And now? We’re not just watching history unfold... you and I are
making it.

FRIEND, JUST LOOK AT THE MOVEMENT WE’VE BUILT:

🔥 A network of 820,000+ conservative student activists

🔥 1,800+ college and high school chapters

🔥 All 50 states. No territory unclaimed.

🔥 16 BILLION+ total views across online platforms.

🔥 5 MILLION+ daily viewers online.

🔥 Over 10 million young people turned away from the Left.

🔥 Students rising up — even in DEEP Blue states.

Fellow patriot, we’re not just winning arguments and “owning the
libs” anymore...

We’re winning hearts. We’re changing minds. We’re turning the
tide.

This generation wasn’t “lost.” _They were LIED to._

BUT BECAUSE OF PATRIOTS LIKE YOU — THEY’RE HEARING THE TRUTH.
THEY’RE FINDING THEIR VOICES. THEY’RE DISCOVERING THEIR COURAGE.
THEY’RE FALLING IN LOVE WITH THIS COUNTRY AGAIN!

[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

_Praise God!_

And you know what? This generation is just getting started.

BUT LET ME SAY THIS CLEARLY: THE BATTLE IS FAR FROM OVER.

The Left is on the ropes — but still dangerous.

They’re doubling down with new tactics. They’re more aggressive
than ever in our schools, our media, and our digital spaces.

They’re coming after our students harder than ever before —
because they know we’re winning.

_We cannot give them back an inch._

So now, as we look back on how far we’ve come... It’s time to
fight even harder.

We’re going to press in. We’re going to drive deeper into enemy
territory.

WE’RE GOING TO REACH MORE STUDENTS, TRAIN MORE LEADERS, AND DESTROY
MORE STRONGHOLDS OF LEFTIST CONTROL.

Not with violence. Not with hate. But with truth. With courage. And
with patriots like YOU standing shoulder-to-shoulder with us.

Friend, I want you to feel proud as you read this today.

Because this movement — the energy, the fire, the growth, the
headlines — belongs to patriots like you...

The grassroots patriots who lit the match... fanned the flames...
stood in the gap.

AND NOW, WE’RE RAISING UP THE MOST CONSERVATIVE, MOST PATRIOTIC,
MOST FIRED-UP YOUTH GENERATION IN 50 YEARS.

That’s not hype. That’s reality. And it’s only possible because
of our proud supporters, people like you, who never gave up.

I CAN’T SAY THANK YOU ENOUGH TO THE PATRIOTS WHO’VE FOUGHT
ALONGSIDE US... THOSE WHO LOVED THIS COUNTRY ENOUGH TO INVEST IN ITS
FUTURE... THOSE WHO BELIEVED THIS COUNTRY WAS WORTH SAVING.

Let’s keep our foot on the gas. Let’s keep changing minds. Let’s
keep winning this culture war.

Because we were never supposed to be winning... And yet... here we
are.

For America,

Charlie Kirk
Founder & CEO
Turning Point USA

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

P.S. Friend, thank you for reading what was admittedly a long email.

But I wanted you to know how far we’ve come and how thankful I am
for patriots like you!

And if this message stirred something in you... If you’d be proud to
be a part of the movement that’s going to save our GREAT nation...

If you want to see even MORE students come alive for truth, for God,
and for America...

And if you’ve been waiting for the right moment to take your
stand...

THIS IS IT. THIS IS YOUR CHANCE TO POUR FUEL ON THE FIRE THAT PATRIOTS
LIKE YOU HELPED START.

When you make your generous gift to Turning Point USA today, you
won’t just be supporting a cause anymore — you’ll be powering a
cultural REVOLUTION.

You’ll be reaching students with the truth. You’ll be changing
hearts and minds.

And most of all, you’ll be lighting more young hearts on fire for
freedom and American Greatness!

LET’S CARRY THE MOMENTUM THROUGH TO EVERY CAMPUS, EVERY PLATFORM,
EVERY CULTURAL STRONGHOLD UNTIL WE WIN. JOIN TURNING POINT USA WITH
YOUR GENEROUS TAX-DEDUCTIBLE GIFT TODAY.
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/14af5fe6-5de7-4bdf-b92e-089c6fd358b4?source_code=MAWCO66263&utm_term=lrm-active]

## Mick Ralphs, Guitarist for Mott the Hoople and Bad Company, Passes Away – RedState

Yesterday, Governor Ned Lamont vetoed the controversial omnibus bill HB5002. This is a major win for local control and Lamont even expressed **** concern over local control and that the bill had too much power to encourage the development of affordable housing.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..wgeAUIatPvX8QccKi6X89tu7ALSSwqpNTah3KL-tDmI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=166719191)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=166719191&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY2NzE5MTkxLCJpYXQiOjE3NTA3NjgwMjAsImV4cCI6MTc1MzM2MDAyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.wj6Qpu_bidF3MuR4_CO3qd_YfnQ6FEn3hk8zf0wa-xs)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b23beec3-ae1d-4fc4-97d2-5cf80dea47a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**We would like to thank[CT169 Strong ](https://substack.com/redirect/610217c3-ea9b-4867-96c6-6a177dbe6b4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)for their efforts in mobilizing more than 10,000 quick petitions to Lamont's office from 166 of the 169 municipalities in Connecticut. It is because of citizens getting vocal and pressure from municipalities (representing their constituents) and other advocacy groups that Lamont's office was flooded with pressure.**
In vetoing this bill, Lamont stated: "I think for housing to continue growing successfully, it has to be led by our towns, it has to be led by our first selectmen, it has to be led by our mayors," To that end, he did note that the towns should take that lead in determining the appropriate number of housing units rather than a Hartford mandate which was the basis of HB5002 that was passed at 2 AM on a Saturday morning.
This bill was rife with issues and did not have sufficient local buy-in. Some other issues included no responsibility for developers to put in off-street parking and conversions as-of-right and "transit-oriented development"
Lamont expressed a desire to have a special session to amend this bill in September.
In addition, Lamont also vetoed legislation that provided unemployment insurance to to workers on strike.
_**This is an example that your voice does matter and we will all continue to push to bring these issues to you so we need you to spread this message. It is still amazing how so many Nutmeggers were not aware of this issue. So you must go out and tell your neighbors and get active.**_
PLEASE SHARE
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=166719191&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY2NzE5MTkxLCJpYXQiOjE3NTA3NjgwMjAsImV4cCI6MTc1MzM2MDAyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.wj6Qpu_bidF3MuR4_CO3qd_YfnQ6FEn3hk8zf0wa-xs)
[Pledge your support](https://substack..wgeAUIatPvX8QccKi6X89tu7ALSSwqpNTah3KL-tDmI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=166719191)
**Your quality of life should not be a political issue, but it has become one in a one-party ruled state like Connecticut.**
It should be noted that the mission of CT 169 is: _CT169 Strong is a non-partisan group dedicated to local zoning control to ensure thoughtful and appropriate development of our communities through prudent land use decision making. We are thankful to the many supporters and especially to the Democrat and Republican legislators who rejected the burdensome and poorly crafted "top down" zoning bills that were introduced to the House. We continue to fight for policies that work and make Connecticut better - and demand effective reforms that create true affordability, not just density._
**It is non-partisan and citizens of all parties contacted Lamont 's office.**

BOJANIKUS/GETTY IMAGES
When we talk about war, many still picture bombs in the air and boots on the ground. But those images, while emotionally resonant, are increasingly outdated.
Today, some of the most consequential battles happen behind keyboards.
The U.S., Iran, China, and Russia are among the world's most advanced cyber powers. And when tensions flare, cyber weapons are often the first tools of retaliation.
Over the weekend, the United States launched targeted strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities. Iran then attacked our forces in Qater. But here's the truth: Iran was already striking back. Not with missiles at first, but with malware.
Three weeks ago, hackers infiltrated UNF, a major supplier to Whole Foods. This resulted in a collapsed inventory system, empty shelves, and disrupted supply chains. Customers were confused. But the message was clear: this was no glitch. It was a warning.
Hershey and Tyson Foods, two of America's largest food companies, made aware of what might be coming, issued quiet alerts to staff before the U.S. even launched its latest operation--codenamed _Midnight Hammer_.
If you're reading this, you might think: What does this have to do with me?
Everything.
If you think cyberattacks don't affect you, think again. You don't need to work in the military to be caught in the crossfire.
## **Iran 's Robust Cyber Arsenal**
As a Commissioner on the US Cyberspace Solarium Commission, the 5th domain of war (after land, sea, air & space), cyber kept me up at night. Iran uses cyber as a key pillar in their asymmetric strategy. Hopefully you recognize their digital tools: 1) Phishing (email campaigns to steal credentials); 2) Denial of Service Attacks (disrupts services and renders critical infrastructure temporarily inaccessible); 3) Targeting US Critical Infrastructure (85% of our critical intrastructure is in the private sector, think electrical grids and water plants); 4) Malware (previousky Iran used 'Shamoon' to delete data); and Disinformation (using AI to leverage social media with fake images, news and videos)
### **Why Americans Are at Greater Risk**
Let's hope the ceasefire between Iran, Israel, and the US that was announced by President Trump holds. Those of us who've seen combat - I lost 19 of my brothers in Baghdad, Iraq - are the ones who crave peace the most. We fight battles on behalf of our nation in hopes that our children don't have to.
But Americans - especially American businesses - have been getting crushed.
## **Veterans Have Been Targets**
Veterans are among the most respected citizens in this country--and among the most vulnerable when it comes to cyberattacks.
According to multiple studies:
* **71%** of Veterans and service members have been victims of cybercrime or identity theft--compared to **60%** of the general population.

* Veterans are 40% more likely to be victims of online exploitation.

* Between 2017 and 2021, the military community reported **over $820 million** in cybercrime-related losses.

Veterans are high-value cyber targets for a variety of reasons.
* **Targeted by Scammers:** Scammers often pose as the VA, healthcare providers, or military support programs. All they need is a little personal info to commit fraud.

* **Social Engineering:** Your service makes you a respected figure in your community--and an ideal target for phishing scams and malware traps.

* **Tech Gaps:** Not all Veterans are fluent in the latest digital tools, which makes it easier for scammers to exploit outdated systems or lax security habits.

* **Isolation:** Older Vets, especially those in hospice or retirement care, may be more vulnerable when seeking online connection or support.

* **Data Exposure:** The military's historical reliance on Social Security numbers and centralized records has left a digital trail vulnerable to breaches.

## **What You Can Do: Basic Cyber Hygiene**
Here's what every Veteran should be doing right now:
1. **Enable Two-Factor Authentication** (2FA) on all accounts--banking, email, VA, and benefits portals. This is your first line of defense. If someone gets your password, 2FA adds a second gate--usually a code sent to your phone or an app. Set it up on all critical accounts, even your social media.

2. **Use strong, unique passwords** : Hackers use automated tools that can guess millions of common passwords in seconds. Use long, unique passphrases or get a password manager like LastPass or 1Password. It's worth it.

3. **Stay skeptical.** Never give out personal info over phone, text, or email unless _you_ initiated the contact.

4. **Update your software.** Yes, those notifications are annoying. But they patch vulnerabilities hackers exploit.

5. **Watch your Wi-Fi:** Avoid checking bank accounts or logging into sensitive platforms on public Wi-Fi (like at the airport or coffee shop). If you must, use a Virtual Private Network (VPN).

6. **Check with the VA or Cybercrime Support Network** if you're unsure about a message or need help recovering from a breach.

### **Veteran Success: The Cybersecurity Gap**
The world needs 3.4 million cybersecurity professionals, and Veterans are uniquely equipped to fill the gap.
Having a security clearance, like most military personnel have, gives you a leg up. Also, who's better equipped to defend against a threat you can't always see, under pressure, with lives on the line?
Veterans already know how to lead under stress, assess risk in real time, and secure critical infrastructure. You've done it in combat zones, at sea, in foreign embassies--and now, the battlefield is digital.
Hospitals, power grids, banks, small businesses, even election systems--they're all vulnerable. And they all need protectors.
Veterans aren't just potential hires. They're mission-ready.
This isn't just about defense. It's about building the future.
America is strongest when her warriors come home and keep leading--in the classroom, the boardroom, and yes, the server room.
No matter where you stand politically, we can all agree: our Veterans deserve to be safe, informed, and empowered in a digital world that changes by the hour.
So take the time. Tighten your settings. Call your buddy. And keep standing guard--not just for your country, but for yourself.
Because the fight might be digital, but the courage is still very real.

Fellow activist,

Today marks the third year since the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ decision, which resulted in the fall of _Roe v. Wade_.

**Today, we want to make one thing clear: this November, reproductive health care will be on the ballot here in Pennsylvania, and we must do everything we can to ensure abortion is protected across the Commonwealth. **

Three of the Democratically elected PA Supreme Court Justices will be up for non-partisan retention elections – Christine Donahue, Kevin Dougherty, and David Wecht – and Republicans have one goal: erasing the Democrats' 5-2 advantage on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court so they can further strip away our rights.

[**Electing justices to the Supreme Court who will protect our rights and freedoms, including access to abortion, has never been more important. Will you help support our voter engagement, education and mobilization work by donating $25 today?**](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9Yr19exo8ATdRfiqRDml-2FPz7N1bdan8dqslucv3braa57iroH1-2FNyT9glGiUy6uuKR8yB86-2BbveWZN-2Bh41KDQ-2FdRqkMUQGNh03Q0atGlldDpJ9YsO6H9982I-2FdRpe0NtqMFNRXj19bcgCr-2BYE6c7COgo-3D9Y2v_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrYePmjQlA8QVndIWn7hV-2BkGGiAHKhmzJUjuVWhVa6g-2FzfCqcu3ckyb5pDLS4yo8z5zwMNP40butWJNVahc1C0f6bR3eRezJh2SaYuca8p-2B35jDVYLqjbQXj-2F71oVAqhnfsllv8-2FPGfrjWFm4SQACn7SEoguKu0ga8T-2BWDGQ3f6aiMCBl8khiuHX0F-2Bm7uG5j8M)

**Here’s why this matters: **

While abortion is currently protected up to 24 weeks of pregnancy in PA with restrictions, it is not enshrined in the PA state constitution, which means it can be banned or limited at any time.

However, according to an article published by _Pittsburgh City Paper_ , there was a court ruling (_Allegheny Reproductive Health Center v. Pennsylvania Department of Human Services_) that challenged one of the restrictions. The PA Supreme Court overturned a precedent and ruled that the state’s Medicaid program's refusal to cover abortion is sex discrimination.

This case “marked the first time a state Supreme Court decision impacted abortion rights after Dobbs, paving a new way to _**protect**_ reproductive rights including abortion through state-level Equal Rights Amendments.”

This case is vulnerable, and it’s critical that our state courts remain fair and independent in order to protect our rights.

[**Despite what’s at stake, judicial races often get little attention. That is why we are already working hard to ensure that voters are informed and ready to make their voices heard. On the third anniversary of the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , help support our critical civic education and engagement programs by donating $25 or whatever you can.**](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9Yr19exo8ATdRfiqRDml-2FPz7N1bdan8dqslucv3braa57iroH1-2FNyT9glGiUy6uuKR8yB86-2BbveWZN-2Bh41KDQ-2FdRqkMUQGNh03Q0atGlldDpJNRPwA9ZbcouS-2Br3zb-2FqYmJKag59yYiHf6sSiP4YaY6Q-3D2tHB_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrYePmjQlA8QVndIWn7hV-2BkGGiAHKhmzJUjuVWhVa6g-2FzeSUx-2Fs0Q6omoxfZsiaQJgTL7aA7J3YnwwS-2BLKpJiKQIMhWTbQcEdRJuEEkvKT-2FJlZAhXeXiznWY09lhk8s9Vr0B8Ey2S-2BOouQLlSOEdVkNqrvhhgvVw9FBGeFHCCMUCwYarWdJjR-2BAuP9vi0AJlPrz)

clean_body: | | | Fellow activist, Today marks the third year since the Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization decision, which resulted in the fall of Roe v. Wade. Today, we want to make one thing clear: this November, reproductive health care will be on the ballot here in Pennsylvania, and we must do everything we can to ensure abortion is protected across the Commonwealth. Three of the Democratically elected PA Supreme Court Justices will be up for non-partisan retention elections – Christine Donahue, Kevin Dougherty, and David Wecht – and Republicans have one goal: erasing the Democrats' 5-2 advantage on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court so they can further strip away our rights. Here’s why this matters: While abortion is currently protected up to 24 weeks of pregnancy in PA with restrictions, it is not enshrined in the PA state constitution, which means it can be banned or limited at any time. However, according to an article published by Pittsburgh City Paper , there was a court ruling (Allegheny Reproductive Health Center v. Pennsylvania Department of Human Services) that challenged one of the restrictions. The PA Supreme Court overturned a precedent and ruled that the state’s Medicaid program's refusal to cover abortion is sex discrimination. This case “marked the first time a state Supreme Court decision impacted abortion rights after Dobbs, paving a new way to protect reproductive rights including abortion through state-level Equal Rights Amendments.” This case is vulnerable, and it’s critical that our state courts remain fair and independent in order to protect our rights. The Antimonopolist [https://www.zephyrteachout.site/r/8004862d?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21]

Cuomo is trying to claw his way back to power TODAY [https://www.zephyrteachout.site/r/394dbf42?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21]

By Zephyr Teachout • 18 Jun 2025

View in browser [https://www.zephyrteachout.site/r/1435999b?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21]

View in browser [https://www.zephyrteachout.site/r/f09c974b?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21]

Zohran for NYC Mayor!

Hey there,

I know I haven't written in a while, I had a nightmare.

I dreamed that Andrew Cuomo was trying to claw his way back into power by moving to New York City from Westchester and trying to buy the office of New York City Mayor.

How is this possible? The man was a rolling corruption scandal as Governor, so shoddy and corrupt with his economic development projects that several of his closest associates were charged with federal crimes. He lied to Congress about the nursing home deaths he caused, making him vulnerable to a big federal criminal investigation. He sexually harassed 12 women who worked for him, and then retaliated against them when a report found that they were credible. He starved the MTA and public schools and even now opposes a law that would make class sizes less than 34 kids.

Cuomo is backed by Bill Ackman, one of the biggest Iran warmongers and Trump supporters, and Bill Clinton, who bombed Iraq in 1998 to distract the country from his sexual harassment impeachment trial.

I ran against Cuomo in a long-shot campaign in 2014, and we shook up the establishment enough to help force him to ban fracking and push for $15 an hour minimum wage. But this time, we need to defeat him for good, and the entire corrupt, bullying politics he represents.

Don't rank Cuomo if you're in New York City.

Instead, put Zohran Mamdani at the top of your ballot. Zohran is really a force of nature, and, as importantly, he's built a grassroots force of volunteers that are in every corner of the city--I went canvassing last night, and I was the oldest by 20 years, and we ran up and down apartment stairs and had real, human, hard and funny conversations--the kind that's only possible if you have 50,000 volunteers willing to spend the time. I've never seen a mayoral campaign so deeply connected to the city.

I first met Zohran five years ago while working on democratic reforms in Albany (speaking of Cuomo and corruption). And the extraordinary Lina Khan and I did an event with him a few weeks ago on some of the great things a city can do to protect small businesses against monopoly abuses.

I'm not a DSA member, I'm an antimonopolist, not a democratic socialist (you can be both, its just not where I land), and I was pretty skeptical of Zohran at first to be honest--not just that he could win, but that he really had a vision that could work. But while his love for the city is boundless--as is his energy--his plans for free buses and rent freeze are rock solid and important. That boundless energy and engagement is what led him to think about other ways to help New Yorkers, like taking on noncompete agreements (we can ban them in New York City), and junk fees, and the all-powerful and problematic Con Edison.

In short, I've been completely impressed with how deeply he listens and learns and above all how much he cares.

No one else is in a position to win, but I'd encourage ranking Brad Lander, Zellnor Myrie, Adrienne Adams, and Michael Blake--or Scott Stringer.

Also: I’ve just started writing again as a columnist at The Nation. Here’s some of my latest column on AI, monopoly, and who gets to shape the future:

We understand, almost intuitively, that geography is not an afterthought to politics, but the substrate on which political life is built. The flat, fertile land along the Hudson River enabled large estates and semifeudal tenant farming in the 18th and 19th centuries, which in turn led to hierarchical systems of local government. The stony hills of Vermont, by contrast, discouraged such consolidation and lent themselves to smallholder farming, Congregational churches, and democratic wrangling through town meetings. The geographies themselves didn’t have meaning, but they were not side issues: They created the material conditions that made it easier for certain systems to flourish while others faltered.

The same is true for information technology. And yet too often, we treat IT as abstract and neutral, obscuring our ability to see power itself and to fight the necessary battles we need to govern ourselves.

Read the rest here [https://www.zephyrteachout.site/r/6054ffbb?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21]. Thanks for still being here.

More soon,

Zephyr Teachout

**This is America...**
Where your taxes fuel a system that replaces American workers with cheap foreign labor.
Where H-1B visas replace American tech workers with low-cost foreign coders.
Where H-2B visas import truck drivers with limited English to haul freight for pennies, living out of their rigs.
Where programs like DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals) and TPS (Temporary Protected Status) grant "non-domiciled CDLs" to non-citizens, allowing them to drive U.S. highways with minimal English and little knowledge of U.S. roads.
Where B-1 visas let Canadians and Mexicans cross the border to haul international loads (with many sneaking into domestic routes and breaking the law).
Where your tax dollars bankroll a system that floods farms with H-2A visa laborers, forced to work in brutal conditions for pennies picking crops turned into cheap corn syrup poison-laced food. Subsidies were roughly $20 billion a year (for mostly corn and soybeans that make our young men gay) to churn out processed junk that fuels health crises and fattens Big Pharma's profits.
This is America...
Where H-2A's uncapped visas (over 300,000 in 2025), replace American workers with exploited foreign labor, keeping costs low and food toxic, all on your dime.
Where visa overstays and illegal aliens are trapped in debt bondage on U.S. farms. The ones who came here illegally face unspeakable wickedness and horrors just to reach the fields, propping up the same system your taxes subsidize.
Welcome to America!
_**Where corporate slavers, cartels, and foreign nationals hijack immigration loopholes and manipulate systems to obliterate wages and bury American workers.**_

body:
Normally when I write to you via email, I like them to be different from the other messages you get from most elected officials.
#
Friends —
Normally when you see my name in your inbox, I like the messages to be different from the other emails you get from most elected officials.
I've written to you in detail about the depth of corruption and self-enrichment of the Trump Administration, the President's thirst for political retribution and intimidation, along with other things I am seeing or working on in Washington, D.C. and at home in Georgia.
This message is different. It's more direct.
I am reaching out today with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign before our end-of-quarter fundraising drive comes to a close. Here's why:
This race will be one of the most competitive and expensive in the nation. I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024 and that makes me MAGA’s #1 target.
In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.
Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please split a contribution between my re-election campaign and The Long Run today before our end-of-quarter fundraising drive comes to a close.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-ossoff.w1PR_G&refcode=em250623-1-nor&t=1&akid=5573%2E196590%2ElG6PQ4)

# [Don't let Trump's moronic tariffs bankrupt Social Security](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1211a6a3-1fad-47d3-a1bf-cdbc438a1ace/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Donald Trump's impressively moronic tariffs are already poised to do two practically contradictory things at once -- slow the economy AND drive up inflation. You have to be a special kind of stupid to do both concurrently. It's like causing a flood and a drought in the same place at the same time. **And now he's going for the trifecta -- by[bankrupting Social Security](https://default.salsalabs.org/T36e7743b-f5d5-411e-b05c-701a3fd1efff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9):** _" Many economists have expressed concern that the risk of higher unemployment and economic contraction has risen significantly because of the tariff chaos — possibly leading to a recession. Lower labor force participation and earnings would lead to lower Social Security revenues, reducing trust fund solvency." ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T162bceb8-8a22-4935-bde1-038d0f0d1683/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ Social Security reserves are already projected to be [depleted in 2034](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdda62999-4cd1-4e89-8eb5-bf1574c76d7c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) \-- a year faster than the projtection this time last year. We need to protect it, not push it towards bankruptcy through the asinine and destructive policies of a madman. **Congress has the power to reject these crazed tariffs, and reduce the threat to Social Security. It should do so NOW.** [**Add your name: Don't let Trump's moronic tariffs bankrupt Social Security**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1648564-385d-4d8b-a854-55e98b2cfb54/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

# STOP THE NEEDLESS STEAL OF OUR CURRENT RIGHTS!
---
|
---
| **(SO CALLED) REPUBLICANS IN THE OHIO LEGISLATURE ARE TRYING TO TAKE AWAY YOUR RIGHT TO OPPOSE ZONING DECISIONS BY RAISING THE NUMBER OF SIGNATURES NEEDED FOR CITIZEN-INITIATED BALLOT REFERENDUMS TO AN EXORBITANT LEVEL!**
The Ohio House and Ohio Senate are working to pass their operating budget, identified as HB 96, or House Bill 96.

**The Ohio Senate has amended the Ohio House budget and increased the signatures needed for citizen-initiated zoning referendums from 15% to 35%! This will effectively take away the ability for We The People to put zoning referendums on the ballot. The only way to get rid of this is to tell the members of the House Finance Committee to amend this provision to 15% before the final budget bill is dropped, which will be on or before Monday, June 30.**

Before 2023, the threshold for such a referendum was 8% of the total votes cast in the prior gubernatorial election, but the threshold was raised to 15% in 2023, which was an 87.5% increase. Now they're trying to raise it again to 35% of the total votes cast in the prior gubernatorial election, which is another 133% increase over the current 15% threshold, and a massive 337% increase over the 2023, 8% threshold. Clearly someone wants to force their will on the public regarding zoning issues!

We are asking you to **USE OUR AUTOMATED DIGITAL ACTIVISM SYSTEM** to call, email, and post on the social media of, your State Representative, your State Senator, and members of the Ohio House Finance Committee to let them know that you oppose them voting to approve HB 96 as long as this referendum increase is part of this bill.

FOR OHIO SECRETARY OF STATE
FIRST CAMPAIGN FILING DEADLINE:

**MARCELL STRBICH IS RUNNING FOR
OHIO SECRETARY OF STATE
AS A REPUBLICAN POLITICAL OUTSIDER!**
[**strbichforohio.com**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=e4ca78d7d2&e=5c740fa3e2)
Many across Ohio already know: Marcell is the right person for this job. He’s a combat veteran, devoted family man, God-fearing patriot, and a proven election integrity advocate. Marcell has been instrumental in drafting nearly every meaningful election integrity bill proposed in Ohio—legislation that’s been deliberately ignored by two consecutive General Assemblies.

Until we see real campaign finance reform, grassroots Ohioans are going to need to dig deep, open their wallets, and be willing to make a personal financial commitment.

_**"In politics, money talks, and campaign filings are how that message gets delivered—loud and clear."**_

It’s important for political candidates to show strong fundraising success in their required government filings because, WHETHER WE LIKE IT OR NOT, money signals momentum, viability, and power—both to insiders and voters. Here’s why it matters:
* Big fundraising numbers make a candidate look like a serious contender. Media, party leaders, donors, and voters all use these filings to gauge who’s competitive and worth taking seriously. Strong fundraising hauls get picked up in headlines: “Candidate Raises $250K in First Quarter”. This creates free publicity and positions the campaign as rising or dominant.
* Party insiders, elected officials, and political organizations often withhold endorsements until they see who can raise money and win. High fundraising can trigger snowball support from power brokers who want to back a winner. Strong numbers can scare off challengers, who may not want to go up against a financially strong opponent.
* Grassroots supporters want to feel they’re backing a campaign that has momentum and a path to victory. Public fundraising reports serve as a psychological boost to volunteers and potential new donors.
* Fundraising equals field operations, advertising, legal support, and more. A candidate who’s raising well is seen as having the infrastructure to compete.

Fundraising filings are more than compliance—they’re performance scorecards. They influence media, endorsements, donor psychology, and even the ballot itself.

**Marcell's first deadline is June 30th.** Shortly after that, his filings are due and the public, including potential donors & the media, will gauge Marcell's financial competitiveness.

**BECAUSE OHIO ONLY REQUIRES A JUNE 30TH AND DECEMBER 31ST FILINGS THIS YEAR, MARCELL WILL NOT HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO SHOW FUNDRAISING MUSCLE TO THE PUBLIC UNTIL 2026!**

**THIS IS WHY IT'S IMPORTANT THAT IF YOU'RE GOING TO DONATE YOU DO IT NOW, AND DONATE AS MUCH AS YOU CAN!**

**DONATE BY CHECK:**

PO Box 21174
Roanoke, VA 24018**

Please text 614-499-0599 if you need ACH or wire transfer information.

_**Maximum donation is $16,615.67.**_

**THANK YOU! **

The Moms for America Podcast sat down with two influential fathers using their public roles to advocate for our children. Tim
Kennedy is a best-selling author, Master Sergeant in the U.S. Army, Green Beret Sniper, and retired MMA and UFC fighter. Pastor
John Amanchukwu is an author, speaker, and activist. Pastor John gained notoriety for his viral videos, confronting school boards
who were allowing pornographic books in their libraries.

These two men are powerful examples of fathers taking the lead on protecting our kids and making American education great again.

Pastor John gained notoriety for his viral videos, confronting school boards who were allowing pornographic books in their libraries. These two men are powerful examples of fathers taking the lead on protecting our kids and making American education great again. Like, subscribe and share. body:

| | Today is the anniversary of the _Dobbs_ Supreme Court decision, the case that overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , decimated abortion rights across the country and opened the door to right-wing attacks on reproductive healthcare. **I am proudly pro-choice and believe that the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right.** The Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ immediately stripped millions of Americans of their fundamental right to lifesaving health care – and left millions more scared and outraged. Bad news for everyone, Team: The state of Georgia is seeking another Supreme Court showdown over the Voting Rights Act, asking a federal appeals court to interpret the 1965 law in a way that could make it much harder to prove minority votes have been illegally diluted.
Georgia is trying to persuade the judges to make up a new, harder-to-prove standard that could hobble Voting Rights Act lawsuits, less than two years after the U.S. Supreme Court turned back a separate challenge from Alabama to the VRA.
From the AP: " A lawyer for the state asked a three-judge panel of the 11th Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals in Atlanta to overturn a lower court that required lawmakers to draw more Black-majority electoral districts. Georgia’s Republican Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger argued in court filings that the Voting Rights Act is being misused to bolster Democratic election chances and that white voters prefer Republicans for nonracial reasons. "

name: Leslie Mehta
subject: The fall of Roe wasn't the end. It was the beginning.
disclaimer_text:
Paid For By
Leslie Mehta for Delegate
body:
Hi Peter,

Three years ago today, Roe v. Wade was overturned, and the consequences have been devastating.

Since the Dobbs decision, states across the country have passed dangerous bans that put lives at risk, criminalize healthcare providers, and roll back decades of progress. Virginia has held the line so far, but extremist politicians are working overtime to change that.

My opponent’s voting record makes it very clear exactly where he stands on reproductive rights. In just his first year in office, Mark Earley:

* Voted against a bill to enshrine reproductive freedom into the Virginia Constitution
* Voted against three separate bills to protect the right to obtain and use contraceptives and two to require insurance coverage on contraceptives
* Voted against five bills aimed at protecting providers and patients from criminalization, data tracking, and out-of-state prosecution
* Sponsored a partial abortion ban

Earley has taken a firm anti-choice position across ten different bills, voting against fundamental reproductive rights protections and for restrictive measures, even in cases involving privacy or health equity. He opposes not only abortion access but key supportive policies like contraceptive coverage and patient/provider protections.

I’m running because I believe that every Virginian deserves the freedom to make their own healthcare decisions—without fear, without interference, and without politicians in the exam room.

This election could decide whether Virginia becomes the next state to fall.

Help us fight back—your support fuels a campaign ready to protect reproductive freedom in all its forms. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tfcwhyleslie?refcode=20250624dobbs&refcode2=txt1]

Donate Now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tfcwhyleslie?refcode=20250624dobbs&refcode2=btn1]

Want to do more to help safeguard our rights?

Get Involved [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdoYPwqriq8_3m4ESCmn8uAR32hslEQbv2tly6xsVFyda3jwA/viewform?usp=dialog]

In solidarity,
- Leslie

The truth is, we don't have special interests or oil barons in our corner. What we do have is YOU — and a people-powered movement that truly believes we can leave our planet better than we found it. Every race we're investing in this year — from school boards to Congress — was possible because of your continued support. It keeps our organizers in the field. It helps us fight back against Big Oil’s lies online and on the airwaves. It means we can show up for brave climate leaders who refuse fossil fuel money — and help them WIN. But we have to keep going. When I leave this place, I want my grandkids to know that I did everything in my power to create a livable future for them. I have no choice but to dig even deeper into our mission to elect climate leaders who will meet this moment with the urgency it demands. ## About Christine Flowers:

---
Christine is a lifelong Philadelphian, who has a deep attachment to the region. She has been practicing immigration law for over twenty-five years with a specialization in asylum and refugee law, after having taught high school French and Spanish at area schools. In addition to her legal practice, Christine is a syndicated columnist whose opinion pieces appear in newspapers across the country, as well as a regular participant in local radio and television programs that focus on current affairs. A graduate of Merion Mercy Academy, Bryn Mawr College and Villanova Law School, her local roots run deep. This can best be expressed by the fact that her mood is directly related to how well the Eagles, Flyers, Sixers and Phillies are playing at any given moment. Christine is an aunt to one human, two Black Labs and a bearded dragon.

## Wellness update...
If you watch the show or have been reading the newsletter for a while you know I have been on my own MAHA/wellness journey. One of the big things I have done is switched out many of the personal care products (soap, toothpaste, vitamins, etc) and home care products (cleaning supplies, detergent) with products from an American based, family company where wellness is front and center.
If you are interested in finding out what I did, text INFO to 276-500-1185 and join me!
## Trump's biggest win EVER?
The president made the right call.
That's the big takeaway from this weekend's red-letter events.
Trump has been clear that Iran can't have a nuke for years--I'm talking way before he was even thinking about running for president.
Yet previous presidents stood by inept while Iran bolstered its nuclear program.
Heck, at times we practically bankrolled it. Obama literally sent pallets of cash.
But once again, Trump showed that he's laser-focused on putting America first. Like his tariff policy, it may not be "traditional" but it gets results.
In this case, that meant preventing the Iranians from developing nuclear weapons that could be used against the United States.
And guess what?
He played his hand so beautifully that not only are Iran's nuclear facilities practically decimated, he also brokered a ceasefire between Israel and Iran. ...

Peter, Today marks three years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade._ Since then, extremists across the country have worked to block health care providers from delivering essential care. They’ve tried to stop women from making their own medical decisions. Dear fellow American,

I’ve spent my life fighting for Wyoming — because this is my home. I was born and raised on a cattle ranch in Laramie County, and my roots here run deep.

I know what it means to work hard, live free, and take pride in where you come from. That’s the Wyoming way — and it’s exactly what I’ve taken with me to Washington.

From my years in the State Legislature to serving as your U.S. Senator, I’ve never stopped fighting to protect the values that make Wyoming strong and America great.

**Whether it’s securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, or creating good-paying jobs, I’ve always put Wyoming and America first.**

As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a member of the conservative Senate Steering Committee, I pushed back against the Biden administration’s extreme agenda — especially when it came to reckless spending, anti-energy mandates, and efforts to lock up our lands.

I’ve fought to protect our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries, because I know how vital they are — not just to Wyoming’s economy, but to America’s future.

This year, I’ve also been fighting to cut red tape, secure our border, and lead on crypto policy that protects innovation and freedom. **I’m in the Senate to make Washington work for Wyoming — _not the other way around._**

_But now, our work is under serious threat._

**Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026.** They know that without the Senate, they can’t ram through their radical agenda.

That’s why they’re pouring money into races across the country — including right here in the West — trying to tip the balance of power in their favor.

**_We can’t let that happen._**

If we lose our Senate majority, we lose the ability to block dangerous policies and stand up for the freedoms we hold dear. clean_body: Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026. | Dear fellow American, I’ve spent my life fighting for Wyoming — because this is my home. I was born and raised on a cattle ranch in Laramie County, and my roots here run deep. I know what it means to work hard, live free, and take pride in where you come from. That’s the Wyoming way — and it’s exactly what I’ve taken with me to Washington. From my years in the State Legislature to serving as your U.S. Senator, I’ve never stopped fighting to protect the values that make Wyoming strong and America great. Whether it’s securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, or creating good-paying jobs, I’ve always put Wyoming and America first. As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a member of the conservative Senate Steering Committee, I pushed back against the Biden administration’s extreme agenda — especially when it came to reckless spending, anti-energy mandates, and efforts to lock up our lands. I’ve fought to protect our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries, because I know how vital they are — not just to Wyoming’s economy, but to America’s future. This year, I’ve also been fighting to cut red tape, secure our border, and lead on crypto policy that protects innovation and freedom. I’m in the Senate to make Washington work for Wyoming — not the other way around. But now, our work is under serious threat. Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026. They know that without the Senate, they can’t ram through their radical agenda. That’s why they’re pouring money into races across the country — including right here in the West — trying to tip the balance of power in their favor. We can’t let that happen. If we lose our Senate majority, we lose the ability to block dangerous policies and stand up for the freedoms we hold dear. Will you chip in to help us hold the line and defend our Senate majority? | I’m not in this fight for headlines or personal gain. I’m in it because I love Wyoming and America — and because I believe that with the right leadership, our best days are still ahead. Thank you for standing with me. Friend — Zohran Mamdani has a real shot at becoming the next Mayor of New York City, and I’m proud to support his inspiring campaign.
At a time when our politics is so full of hate, fear, and pessimism, Zohran is running on hope, compassion, and a positive vision for the future.
At a time when some Democrats think we should abandon our values and move towards the center to appease Republicans, Zohran is proving that we can be bold and fight for big progressive ideas that lift up the working class.
Anyone who has been watching this campaign over the last few months has seen the incredible grassroots energy that Zohran has created despite the long odds.
He’s up against a former governor from a New York political dynasty. He’s being outspent 25 to 1 by Super PACs. He’s had to face ridiculous personal attacks and lies about who he is. And still, Zohran’s pulled together one of the greatest grassroots campaigns we’ve seen since Bernie Sanders ran for president.
**Zohran can win today, but it’s going to take everyone’s help.**
If you live in New York City, [**please head to this link**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4482?t=3&akid=1680%2E791427%2EgYQ8RI) and find your polling location. Get to the polls before 9pm today and rank Zohran! You have to be a registered Democrat to vote in the primary.
**[GET OUT AND VOTE!](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4482?t=4&akid=1680%2E791427%2EgYQ8RI)**

**[DONATE HERE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4488?t=6&akid=1680%2E791427%2EgYQ8RI)**
If we are going to build a movement that can take on Trump, beat the far-right across this nation, and deliver on the promise of justice for all, we need more people like Zohran Mamdani running for office and **winning.**
I hope you’ll join me in supporting his campaign on this important day.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

| Peter,

Three years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , stripping away nearly five decades of constitutional protections for abortion care.

Since then, we’ve watched as anti-choice politicians across the country rushed to ban abortion, threaten doctors with jail time, and rip away access to basic reproductive health care.

In some states, we’ve seen just how far the far right is willing to go to control people’s bodies and decisions. And with Donald Trump and Republicans promising a national abortion ban if they win back power, the threat is growing.

I’ve never been afraid to stand up for reproductive rights — and I never will. In Congress, I’ve fought to protect access to abortion, defend Planned Parenthood, and stop extremist attempts to criminalize care.

If we want to protect our fundamental freedoms, we have to stand strong, speak out, and show the anti-choice extremists that we’re not going anywhere.

Every person deserves the right to make their own medical decisions, free from political interference. Help me keep up the fight for reproductive rights and health care access with a grassroots donation today.

Peter, it’s Valerie Foushee -

Today marks 3 years since the United States Supreme Court issued their ruling on _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ , effectively overturning the protections of 1973’s _Roe v. Wade_.

**Over the last 3 years, this decision has had disastrous consequences for the right to bodily autonomy and access to healthcare for folks across the country. And these rights are in peril more than ever before in Trump’s America.**

In his first 5 months in office, Trump has:

❌ **Refused to defend the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act** , which requires hospitals to provide life-saving treatment to all patients in emergency situations - including life-saving abortions

❌ **Frozen millions of dollars in funding for Title X** , the only federal program dedicated to providing Americans with family planning and preventative reproductive health care services including birth control, STI testing, HPV vaccinations, infertility services, and more

❌ S**crubbed federal websites of critical information concerning reproductive health** , including taking down ReproductiveRights.gov and erased all mention of reproductive care from the Department of Health and Human Services website

**In addition, Trump and the GOP are working to pass their “big beautiful bill,” which would strip millions of Americans of their Medicaid access** , which funds 75% of publicly funded family planning reproductive services and 40% of births across the country.

The solution is quite clear: Congress must pass a federal law protecting a woman’s right to choose. But with a GOP majority in both chambers, it’s not looking very likely.
