name: Kamala Harris
subject: I know it’s not easy
body:
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2780?t=1&akid=659%2E2563979%2E5Nrycn)

Peter, Three years ago today, the United States Supreme Court took away the fundamental constitutional right of all people to make decisions about their own bodies.
Many of you reading may remember where you were on that day when the Court overturned _Roe v. Wade._
I was traveling from Washington, DC to a maternal health event in Illinois when I heard the news, and it became clear: Women of this generation would have fewer rights than my generation or my mother's generation.
Our work now is about fighting for all of them and for the generations to come.
Over the past three years, women of our nation have suffered under the consequences of laws made possible by Dobbs. Laws that have created chaos, confusion, and fear. Laws that have denied the women of our country care, even when their life and health were at risk.
There is so much on the line, but it is a noble fight, always, to fight for freedom.
I know it is not easy. I know these are difficult times, and it requires a whole lot of courage. It requires a level of optimism to remember that we're fighting _for_ something, not against something.
So today, [**I am asking you to make a donation to the Democratic National Committee.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250624-1A&refcode2=659_2563979_5Nrycn&akid=659%2E2563979%2E5Nrycn)
The DNC is leading so much of the good and important work to uphold our fundamental reproductive freedoms and to elect a Democratic House and Senate to protect those freedoms in the future.
Donations are critical to their success, and we know that when we fight together, we make a difference. So please:
[**Make a $5 donation to the Democratic National Committee to help fight back against attacks on reproductive freedom and elect Democrats who will protect those rights in the future.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250624-1A&refcode2=659_2563979_5Nrycn&akid=659%2E2563979%2E5Nrycn)

subject: My mother would’ve ripped DEI to shreds
body:
She always taught me our country was built on hard work

| | | | |
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7itndu3r4f5hkicn45a9f0jh07v72uog3e1mbig_)
|

I was raised by a single mother.
I learned to fight with my back against the wall with no way out but through.
So when the radical left Democrats get up in my face & call me a “race-traitor” after I applauded Trump for abolishing DEI, I’m left speechless.
My mom _**never**_ taught me to hate my fellow Americans.
She always instilled in me the values of _hard work_ and _merit._
**If I told her I was a _victim_ like someone in the Woke Mob, she’d probably just laugh like it’s some kind of joke.**
**That’s the America I believe in**. And that’s why I’m a MAGA Patriot who loves President Trump and the America First Movement.
But after I stood with President Trump as he abolished DEI, the attacks against me have been horrendous.
The race-obsessed left just sees me as another Black Man who should sit down, shut up, and vote blue for the rest of my life.
Their hypocrisy _disgusts_ me, and I can brush off most of their attacks, but here’s the _**[real problem](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zbb8bfro32m3umcbvgi0jslavhib1q8iuo55dg1o_)**_ that I can’t solve on my own.
Right now I’m running for Governor in Florida, and truth be told the radical-left is dropping the hammer on me. They’re prepared to spend **millions of dollars** to prop-up a Democrat that could flip MAGA’s hometurf **BLUE**.
I’m committed to being President Trump’s STRONGEST Governor ally in the nation. But I can’t do this alone.
_**[So before the day is over, can I count on your support to keep me in the fight?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z9dn7hfmcmmpu4698va45qt3fgt0opeos5o4iv88_)**_

Peter,
I want to share something really personal with you all today.
In 2022, when far-right extremists on the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , I was sitting in the same healthcare facility where I once had an abortion at 18 after I was sexually assaulted.
We then learned Missouri’s own extremist politicians had made our state the first in the nation to enact a near-total abortion ban. Sitting alongside U.S. Dept. of Health and Human Services Secretary Xavier Becerra, healthcare providers, storytellers, and abortion fund administrators, we were shocked and horrified. However, in that moment, we also knew our fight was far from over.
Now, three years later, we’ve watched the GOP execute their plan to ban abortion nationwide—bit by bit, state by state. They’ve targeted IVF. They’ve tried to ban birth control. And this month, the Trump administration rescinded emergency abortion care protections—stripping away a Biden-era rule that literally saved lives.
This move has only added to the utter confusion, especially in states with extreme restrictions. Doctors are now left unsure whether they can legally provide life-saving care at all.
As someone who has had an abortion, I will ALWAYS fight to affirm access to abortion care as a human right and to expand access to this life-saving healthcare.
We need leaders in Congress who understand that abortion is healthcare; leaders who will fight to repeal the Comstock Act , defend access to medication abortion, and codify reproductive freedom into law. And we’re building a slate of candidates who will do just that. But we need your help to fuel this work.
It’s been three years. I think it’s past time we truly end this madness. Will you make a contribution to Politivist Action PAC right now to help us elect bold, pro-choice progressives across the country? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_email-25q2?refcode=x_250624_dobbs_act]

name: Deb Haaland
subject: A story about child care from when I was a young mom
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO
body:
My child is grown up now, but I’m not done fighting for children across New Mexico.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)
It’s summer. ☀️
If you’re a working parent like I was, you know the summer season means figuring out child care and summertime activities for your kids.
As of 2022, New Mexico’s state constitution guarantees the right to early childhood education, with more than 30,000 families qualifying for _completely free_ child care. It’s an overwhelmingly popular new policy that has lifted thousands of families out of poverty.
**A policy like this one would have been a lifeline for me when I was a young single mom.** I knew the importance of early childhood education, so I was desperate to find Somáh somewhere to attend preschool. Luckily, I found a school that allowed me to volunteer cleaning up classrooms in exchange for a discount on tuition. It was the only way I could have afforded an early childhood education for my child.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250624_1_childcare?amount=5&refcode=em20250624-2802&refcode2=2802_400544_vfMpBz&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)_It shouldn’t cost a fortune to give our kids opportunities to learn._
Child care and early learning shouldn’t be a luxury that only the wealthy have access to. That’s not who we should be as a country. So when MAGA Republicans threaten to take away funding for early education access, it hurts our kids, working parents, and our entire state economy.
**[As governor, I’ll fight fiercely to defend smart policies like free child care and push for more solutions that make New Mexico an incredible place to raise children. Will you contribute $5 to grow our campaign so we can win this race?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250624_1_childcare?amount=5&refcode=em20250624-2802&refcode2=2802_400544_vfMpBz&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250624_1_childcare?amount=5&refcode=em20250624-2802&refcode2=2802_400544_vfMpBz&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)**
Here in New Mexico, we can’t afford to lose an inch of ground when it comes to increasing opportunities for our children. And we still have much more work to do when it comes to improving education outcomes and making life more affordable for families.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250624_1_childcare?amount=5&refcode=em20250624-2802&refcode2=2802_400544_vfMpBz&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)_My child Somáh is grown up now, but I’m not done fighting for children across New Mexico._
That’s why it’s critical that we win this race together. Electing state leaders who understand the urgency around issues like affordable child care and early learning is how we can protect and build upon our progress.
[**If a donation fits into your budget today, would you chip in $5 or any amount you can afford to our campaign for a more affordable New Mexico?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250624_1_childcare?amount=5&refcode=em20250624-2802&refcode2=2802_400544_vfMpBz&akid=2802%2E400544%2EvfMpBz)
Be fierce,
Deb

The Bush Administration lied to America about Iraq’s nuclear program to rush us into war in 2003. Have we learned nothing from that disastrous episode?
When I was elected to the Senate in 2012, I had served as governor from 2006-2010, during a tremendous upsurge in the two wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. I visited our troops multiple times in the Green Zone, in Baghdad and Afghanistan. I went to the deployments and the homecomings. I went to the wakes and the funerals.
And I told myself when I came to the Senate, that if I ever had the chance to stop this nation from getting into an unnecessary war, I would do everything I could to stop it.
I believe that the United States engaging in a war against Iran — a third war in the Middle East since 2001 — would be a catastrophic blunder for this country.
There are some in the Senate who disagree with me on that.
But we should ALL be able to agree, having taken an oath to the Constitution, that the U.S. should not be at war without a vote of Congress.
It’s a fundamental constitutional principle: We shouldn’t be in a war if Congress doesn’t have the guts to debate it and vote on it.
I introduced a war powers resolution that will be subject to a vote on the Senate floor this week about whether or not war should happen without a vote of Congress — and I’m asking you to show your support for it . [https://secure.ngpvan.com/om4WvG6hYE2lckxz0j3dnA2]
My perspective is simple: How dare we ask the men and women serving in our military to make the ultimate sacrifice if we don’t have the spine to have a public debate and decide whether a war is in the interest of this country?
If you agree that any war MUST be debated and voted on by Congress, please add your name today to show your support for my war powers resolution. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/om4WvG6hYE2lckxz0j3dnA2]
Thank you for speaking up with me.
-Tim Kaine

#### **Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process.**
#### **Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

|

**I put these materials together for the good folks of Michigan to help stand strong against Ranked Choice Voting. I’d be honored if you took a moment to visit the website I built—it's something I poured my heart into for the people of that great state. Everything you’ll find there was made with one goal: to help stop Ranked Choice Voting. And I want to be clear—I'm doing this on my own dime, not a penny asked.****If you believe in the work I’m doing to stop Ranked Choice Voting across this country, I humbly ask for your support in helping fund the films I’m making. You’ll find links to that below.****I’m proud to be working with folks from national groups like Stop RCV, and many others that I won’t name. Together, we’re building tools like interactive guides and educational apps to make it easier for everyday Americans to understand what’s really at stake. When you visit the website, I hope you’ll take time to check out the new applications I built right here in Alaska—they explain Ranked Choice Voting in ways folks haven’t seen before.****I also built a custom chatbot that can answer your questions about RCV using the material I’ve written and collected. You’ll find short animated videos and even a full animated short film that tells the story plain and true. My documentary** _**Frozen Odds**_**tells the story of Alaska’s fight against Ranked Choice Voting, and I plan to show it in theaters across Alaska, Oregon, Michigan, and other places where this voting system still threatens the voice of the people.****Thank you for standing with me. These last three years have been a journey I’ll never forget. The friendships and partnerships I’ve built across the country have changed my life—and I believe, together, we can protect our Republic.**

Hi Peter, it's Dr. Maxine Dexter, MD.
The Trump administration is bad for our health—and they’re doing everything they can to make it worse.
Trump’s “Big Ugly Bill” deadline is closing in, and if passed, millions more families will be uninsured, and more people will have to fight through red tape to get the healthcare they need.
Meanwhile, Trump’s VA now allows doctors to deny veterans healthcare based on the patient's politics, marital status, or union activity. That is discrimination. The very people who risked their lives to defend this country can now be refused life-saving treatment by the same government they served.
But the cruelty doesn’t end there.
The Trump administration is using our Medicaid data to carry out its deportation raids.
ICE is not just targeting violent criminals—they’re detaining people who show up for lawful immigration appointments. And in some cases, they’ve even deported people who are here lawfully, like Kilmar Abrego Garcia, without due process. Even American citizens have reported being targeted by ICE based on their race and skin color.
This is what authoritarian governments do.
All the while, Trump and the GOP are slashing healthcare to fund tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy. What’s more, they’re trying to sell off our public lands so these corporations can continue to poison our air and water.
We have to fight like our lives depend on it—because they do.

### Infant and maternal mortality rates continue to spike, with Black and brown women and babies suffering the most
| | [Qasim Rashid, Esq.](https://substack.com/@qasimrashid)
---
| Jun 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@qasimrashid)

Today, June 24, is the three year anniversary that U.S. Supreme Court made the unconscionable decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. In doing so, SCOTUS stripped crucial precedent and life saving healthcare access that women relied on for nearly 50 years. At the time, physicians across the country--particularly OBGYNs--sounded the alarm: this wasn't just about ideology or politics. It was about lives. About health. About whether doctors could do their jobs without interference from politicians who have never stepped foot in an exam room. And now, three years later, the data is in. Those doctors were right, the repeal of Roe has enabled widespread, mass, and preventable death of women and babies. **Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This is made possible by you, the thoughtful person reading this. Consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..DLrJFUb_2a_doKZVSKnANReG-0Xdspzpvvk0SVkrp6k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166730742)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7de52c-a825-4048-91bf-5cf39c96817c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images
## What Was Predicted
For states that have banned abortion access, or severely restricted it, the predictable results have been a spike in maternal mortality and infant mortality. This, again, is no surprise. A study by Colorado University in 2021 warned of this, [concluding](https://substack.com/redirect/6e33cf31-0253-4455-80b9-5099e0bd515c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Banning abortion nationwide would lead to a 21% increase in the number of pregnancy-related deaths overall and a 33% increase among Black women, according to new CU Boulder research.
Another study by Tulane University, prior to Roe's repeal, found the same results in 2018, [concluding](https://substack.com/redirect/d9dadd26-2571-451a-9f37-89f0d6591679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> States with more restrictive abortion policy climate have higher total maternal mortality, measured as a death during pregnancy or within one year following the end of a pregnancy.
## What Has Happened
Post-Roe, these trends have only exacerbated, costing the lives of babies and mothers. A comprehensive post-Roe study conducted by JAMA [found that](https://substack.com/redirect/4b9cafa6-7f2e-490b-aae3-53b127319925?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Published on Oct. 21 (2024) in the journal JAMA Pediatrics, the data concludes that infant mortality rates were up by 7% in three of the first 18 months examined after the _Dobbs_ decision -- an average of 247 _more_ infant deaths. Eighty percent of those deaths can be attributed to congenital anomalies, the report says.
And then there's the deeply racial element. Another study published in early 2025 concluded [that](https://substack.com/redirect/9e6b7296-2027-4d27-85d0-b6b8d2df3be9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_The findings showed the highest mortality occurred among infants who were Black, lived in Southern states or had fetal birth defects_."
Unsurprisingly, therefore, according to recent surveys of practicing OBGYNs, more than 64% report that the fall of _Roe_ has made America's maternal mortality crisis even worse. And that's saying something--because the United States already had the highest maternal mortality rate in the developed world. For example, consider the horrifying story out of Georgia in which a Black mother named Adriana Smith was denied the healthcare she needed and suffered a terminal illness causing her to become braindead. But, because she was six weeks pregnant at the time, [the State of Georgia forced her to remain 'alive' on life without her consent to support to serve](https://substack.com/redirect/550fa526-cd59-4fd2-aaf5-1dd40cc9fdfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as an incubator for the next six months, until the child (who also will suffer from congenital anomalies) could be cut from her corpse.
Likewise, more than 68% of OBGYNs say that treating pregnancy-related medical emergencies has become more difficult--often requiring legal consultations before life-saving care can even begin. For example, Republican Congresswoman Kat Cammack recently [blamed "the left" for medical staff hesitating to treat her ectopic pregnancy](https://substack.com/redirect/df46f869-8f89-478c-b6d9-d5ea7ae19a4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) due to a Republican law that effectively banned abortion, even in life threatening cases like hers. Rep Cammack is fortunate to have the privilege and power to demand care--but what of the millions of women who don't due to the extremist Republican push to repeal Roe?
And finally, more than 70% of OBGYNs report that racial disparities in reproductive health care have gotten worse, further endangering Black and brown women who already face higher rates of complications and death (300% higher to be exact). This is not just a rollback of rights--it's a public health disaster. And it was preventable.
It is no surprise, therefore, that when it comes to infant mortality, the [CDC data ](https://substack.com/redirect/07d7040a-d146-4c09-a0ea-8c255ca359f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)arrives at the same conclusion--banning reproductive health access is killing babies. For example, CDC data reports that 15 of the top 16 states with the _highest_ rates of infant mortality are red states that restrict or deny reproductive healthcare access.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/093e6f4e-14a9-4739-b45c-0cc429513979?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, the CDC data also shows that 12 of the top 13 states with the _lowest_ rates of infant mortality are blue states that protect reproductive healthcare and access.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ff5c9b58-5718-46af-ac9f-97b6d9223598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Put another way, a child is three times more likely to die in Mississippi where reproductive health access is restricted or banned, than in Massachusetts where access is protected and ensured. We might as well be discussing two entirely different countries at this point. So much for red states being "pro life," right?
**This research takes work and needs your support. If you find value in this scholarship, please join us as a paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..DLrJFUb_2a_doKZVSKnANReG-0Xdspzpvvk0SVkrp6k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166730742)
## Where Do We Go From Here?
If you know me, you know my answer is to take action, not sit idle. Here are three things I encourage you to do.
One, Congress must pass the [Women's Health Protection Act of 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/ba43636d-dc63-49a7-bf18-b055752e13bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). More than 70% of Americans across political parties support the right of women to make healthcare decisions without a politician in the doctor's office with them. The WHPA passed the House, but failed in the Senate due to the Jim Crow filibuster. When Biden was President, I called on Democrats to abolish the filibuster and pass this critical piece of legislation. Unfortunately, establishment Dems were more aligned with "norms" than they were with recognizing that failing to pass this legislation will cost untold pain, death, and suffering. This is not complicated, folks. This is basic common sense and basic healthcare. It is critical we continue to publicly advocate for this critical piece of legislation.
Two, I encourage you to continue to support public health experts and organizations dedicated towards advancing better reproductive health policy. This can include Planned Parenthood, NARAL, or my friends at [Repro Ready](https://open.substack.com/pub/pariandeve?utm_source=mentions), who write regularly on public health and reproductive health right here on Substack. (They're an excellent platform to subscribe to as well).
Finally, know that raising your voice matters. Continue to contact your members of Congress to demand they protect reproductive health--it is literally a matter of life and death. Find your member of Congress [here](https://substack.com/redirect/ef18d83c-c92e-4457-978f-3a4758d12809?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
## Conclusion
Ultimately, this isn't just about law or policy--it's about trust. Do we trust women to make decisions about their own bodies? Do we trust doctors to use their training and expertise to save lives without fear of prosecution? Or do we believe politicians--who most notably are _not_ healthcare professionals--should be in the exam room with us?
Trusting women and healthcare professionals led to healthier women and babies. Trusting unqualified politicians has led to mass death and suffering. Why is this even a debate? Every restriction, every delay, every political stunt dressed up as policy is rooted in the belief that women can't be trusted. It's legislative medical malpractice, and it is an abomination to human intellect and human decency.
We must do and demand better. And if we truly respect women--if we truly want to lower maternal mortality, improve infant health, and close racial disparities--then we need to get politicians out of the doctor's office, period. That is what reproductive freedom means. That is what justice demands. And that is what our future must reclaim.

If you find value in this scholarship, please join us as a paid subscriber. Where Do We Go From Here? If you know me, you know my answer is to take action, not sit idle. Here are three things I encourage you to do. One, Congress must pass the . More than 70% of Americans across political parties support the right of women to make healthcare decisions without a politician in the doctor's office with them. The WHPA passed the House, but failed in the Senate due to the Jim Crow filibuster. When Biden was President, I called on Democrats to abolish the filibuster and pass this critical piece of legislation. Unfortunately, establishment Dems were more aligned with "norms" than they were with recognizing that failing to pass this legislation will cost untold pain, death, and suffering. This is not complicated, folks. This is basic common sense and basic healthcare. It is critical we continue to publicly advocate for this critical piece of legislation. Two, I encourage you to continue to support public health experts and organizations dedicated towards advancing better reproductive health policy. This can include Planned Parenthood, NARAL, or my friends at , who write regularly on public health and reproductive health right here on Substack. (They're an excellent platform to subscribe to as well). Finally, know that raising your voice matters. Continue to contact your members of Congress to demand they protect reproductive health--it is literally a matter of life and death. Find your member of Congress . Conclusion Ultimately, this isn't just about law or policy--it's about trust. Do we trust women to make decisions about their own bodies? Do we trust doctors to use their training and expertise to save lives without fear of prosecution? Or do we believe politicians--who most notably are not healthcare professionals--should be in the exam room with us? Trusting women and healthcare professionals led to healthier women and babies. Trusting unqualified politicians has led to mass death and suffering. Why is this even a debate? Every restriction, every delay, every political stunt dressed up as policy is rooted in the belief that women can't be trusted. It's legislative medical malpractice, and it is an abomination to human intellect and human decency. We must do and demand better. And if we truly respect women--if we truly want to lower maternal mortality, improve infant health, and close racial disparities--then we need to get politicians out of the doctor's office, period. That is what reproductive freedom means. That is what justice demands. And that is what our future must reclaim. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. Fellow American,

I didn’t come to Washington to blend in.

I came to fight for Wyoming — the place I was born, raised, and built my life. A cattle ranch in Laramie County taught me everything I needed to know about grit, freedom, and loyalty to your roots.

**Those are the values I bring with me to the Senate every day.**

Whether it’s defending the Second Amendment, securing the border, cutting red tape, or unleashing American energy — I’ve stayed focused on one thing: **delivering for Wyoming and standing up for America First.**

As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a leader on the Senate Steering Committee, I took the fight straight to the Biden administration. Going head-to-head with their out-of-control spending, their war on domestic energy, and their attempts to lock up the lands that belong to us.

I’ve championed our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries — not just because they power Wyoming jobs, but because they power America.

And I haven’t stopped there. I’ve worked to secure the border. I’ve fought for the future of crypto and innovation. And I’ve taken a stand every time Washington tries to forget who it works for.

**But here’s the truth:** Everything we’ve worked for — everything we’ve protected — is under threat.

Democrats are already gearing up for 2026. They’ve made flipping the Senate their top goal — because they know if they win, they can steamroll the rest of their radical agenda.

They’re pouring millions into key races across the country — including right here in the Mountain West.

clean_body: Everything we’ve worked for — everything we’ve protected — is under threat. | Fellow American, I didn’t come to Washington to blend in. I came to fight for Wyoming — the place I was born, raised, and built my life. A cattle ranch in Laramie County taught me everything I needed to know about grit, freedom, and loyalty to your roots. Those are the values I bring with me to the Senate every day. Whether it’s defending the Second Amendment, securing the border, cutting red tape, or unleashing American energy — I’ve stayed focused on one thing: delivering for Wyoming and standing up for America First. As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a leader on the Senate Steering Committee, I took the fight straight to the Biden administration. Going head-to-head with their out-of-control spending, their war on domestic energy, and their attempts to lock up the lands that belong to us. I’ve championed our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries — not just because they power Wyoming jobs, but because they power America. And I haven’t stopped there. I’ve worked to secure the border. I’ve fought for the future of crypto and innovation. And I’ve taken a stand every time Washington tries to forget who it works for. But here’s the truth: Everything we’ve worked for — everything we’ve protected — is under threat. Democrats are already gearing up for 2026. They’ve made flipping the Senate their top goal — because they know if they win, they can steamroll the rest of their radical agenda. They’re pouring millions into key races across the country — including right here in the Mountain West. If they succeed, we lose the ability to hold the line. That’s why I’m reaching out directly: Your support keeps conservatives in the fight — and keeps me in the Senate, fighting for the values Wyoming stands for. 👉 👉 👉 I’m not in this for headlines or handshakes. I’m here because I love Wyoming — and because I know our best days are ahead if we have the courage to fight for them. Thanks for being on my side. — Cynthia U.S. Senator for Wyoming | Follow Cynthia Lummis | Paid for by Lummis for Wyoming Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: .

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Can I send you my recipe for green chile chicken posole?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
Cooking has always been a way for me to foster connection and build community.
Hey Peter – it’s Deb Haaland. I’m running for Governor of New Mexico and Heartland Patriots said I could reach out to you.
One thing you should know about me is that **I love to cook.**
My love of cooking New Mexican cuisine started early, thanks to the hours I spent watching my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She wouldn’t let us kids in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours. I still hold those memories close as I prepare my favorite traditional New Mexican dishes.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90135?refcode=em20250624-9045&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9045%2E614464%2EaF303B) _New Mexico chiles – the best in the world!_
**There’s something powerful about connecting with others over a home cooked meal.** When I was in law school at UNM, I’d make chicken green chile stew for student gatherings, and I made that same dish for my Congressional colleagues during the 2019 winter holiday season. I even cooked chile and tortillas for the water protectors when I traveled to Standing Rock during the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline.
Cooking became more than a hobby after I decided to start my own salsa business. I worked out of a commercial kitchen and bought my red chile pequin from a farm in northern New Mexico. I’d prepare my salsa and deliver jars to mom-and-pop shops across the state, often with Somáh riding with me in the back seat.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90135?refcode=em20250624-9045&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9045%2E614464%2EaF303B) _Here’s Somáh posing with jars of my homemade salsa. Kids in New Mexico start early... 🌶️_
**For me, cooking has always been a way to foster connection and build community, which is exactly what we’re doing now as we grow our campaign for New Mexico.** I’ve had the chance to sit down with New Mexicans in living rooms and at kitchen tables to hear about their lives, their struggles, and their hopes for the future. Every conversation is another reminder of the incredibly high stakes in this race – and proof that if we organize around our shared values, we will win.
**[Will you split $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots today? clean_body: Cooking has always been a way for me to foster connection and build community. Hey Peter – it’s Deb Haaland. I’m running for Governor of New Mexico and Heartland Patriots said I could reach out to you. One thing you should know about me is that I love to cook. My love of cooking New Mexican cuisine started early, thanks to the hours I spent watching my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She wouldn’t let us kids in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours. I still hold those memories close as I prepare my favorite traditional New Mexican dishes. New Mexico chiles – the best in the world! There’s something powerful about connecting with others over a home cooked meal. When I was in law school at UNM, I’d make chicken green chile stew for student gatherings, and I made that same dish for my Congressional colleagues during the 2019 winter holiday season. I even cooked chile and tortillas for the water protectors when I traveled to Standing Rock during the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline. Cooking became more than a hobby after I decided to start my own salsa business. I worked out of a commercial kitchen and bought my red chile pequin from a farm in northern New Mexico. I’d prepare my salsa and deliver jars to mom-and-pop shops across the state, often with Somáh riding with me in the back seat. Here’s Somáh posing with jars of my homemade salsa. Kids in New Mexico start early... 🌶️ For me, cooking has always been a way to foster connection and build community, which is exactly what we’re doing now as we grow our campaign for New Mexico. I’ve had the chance to sit down with New Mexicans in living rooms and at kitchen tables to hear about their lives, their struggles, and their hopes for the future. Every conversation is another reminder of the incredibly high stakes in this race – and proof that if we organize around our shared values, we will win. Hi Peter — We have a big week coming up, so I wanted to personally reach out to you and provide an update on where things stand. Donald Trump has given Republicans a deadline to send their “Big, Beautiful Bill” to his desk by July 4th, and his allies in the Senate are planning to put the bill on the floor _this week. _ Republicans are going to be laser-focused on ramming their bill through the Senate as quickly as possible so they can meet Donald Trump’s July 4th deadline. The GOP’s “Big, Beautiful Bill” isn’t beautiful for anyone unless you’re a billionaire. #
# **Call Your US Senators**
_The fight is not over to stop the passage of the Big, BAD Republican Bill_ [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14794) Right now, the US Senate is getting ready to start voting on the Big, Bad Bill that passed the US House of Representatives a few weeks ago. The bill includes billions in cuts that would strip people of basic services, yet give the wealthiest in our country more money in their pockets. Call your US Senators and tell them you do not support the Big, Bad Bill. [_**Senator John Fetterman**_](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14795) _Philly Office_ 215-241-1090 _Washington DC Office_ 202-224-4254 [_**Senator McCormick**_](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14796) _Philly Office_ 215-405-9660 _Washington DC Office_ 202-224-6324 **What's in the Bill? ** [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14797) Here's what to know...
* This bill will be the biggest cut to healthcare in American history
* It will strip health insurance and care from almost **15 MILLION **Americans

* This bill will be the biggest cut to food assistance in American history
* It will strip **$18 BILLION **in SNAP benefits from households with children

* This bill will make college more expensive for anyone who relies on financial aid and student loans

* This bill will use the money from those cuts to pay for a tax giveaway for the wealthiest in the country

* This bill will add **$3.3 TRILLION** to our country's deficit, which means higher interest rates, bigger credit card bills, and more expensive mortgages

[**Visit our website for more detail about what 's included in the Big BAD Ugly**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14798)
* * *
**Most Americans Do Not Support the Big, BAD Bill** [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14799) [Several surveys show](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14800) that Americans know the Big, Bad Bill will only help the super wealthy and hurt the rest of the country. As the US Senate gets ready to vote on the bill, it's important to let lawmakers know that we do not want cuts to healthcare, food assistance, and student loan support. Call your Pennsylvania Senators and let them know what you think about handouts for the wealthiest in our country.
* * *
**When We Fight, We Win** Now is the time to call your US Senators... _Call Senator Fetterman and ask him to continue to support healthcare and the working class_ _" I will never support any bill that strips Medicaid, Medicare, or SNAP benefits from Americans to bankroll tax cuts for billionaires. Pennsylvania deserves better than this and I'll keep fighting for a government that serves the people, not special interests." _ _- Senator Fetterman _ [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14795) _Call Senator McCormick and ask him to pass legislation that serves the people of Pennsylvania, not the ego of our President._ _" We got to get this Big Beautiful Bill passed and get the President's agenda in action right now. We got to get it done for the President." - Senator McCormick _ [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170216.173049.745&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14796)
* * *

### About Marcy Kaptur

**🌍**
In recent days, we have entered one of the most dangerous moments in modern history.
The escalating war between Israel, Iran, and the United States -- with missile strikes, air bombardments, and threats of retaliation -- has already pushed the Middle East to the brink.
Now, new crises are emerging: India and Pakistan -- both nuclear-armed -- are facing a confrontation over water rights. Russia's war in Ukraine simmers with the risk of renewed offensives. China is watching carefully -- ready to exploit global distraction to press its aims in Taiwan or the South China Sea.
It is not one crisis. It is a global pattern of unraveling -- of the international system, of the old agreements that once held war in check.
We are moving toward what historians call a "chain-reaction war" -- the kind that erupted in 1914.
One spark -- one miscalculation -- could set off a cascade:
-> a general war in the Middle East
-> a nuclear crisis in South Asia
-> escalations in Europe and East Asia
-> a collapse of global trade and economy
-> a world war
I say this not to sow panic -- but because if we name it now, there is still time to stop it.
**❗**
**What can be done?**
This is not inevitable.
Even now -- political leaders, civil society, and ordinary people can make a difference.
We must call, loudly and clearly, for the following:
1️⃣ No attacks on national leaderships -- Do not assassinate Iran's Supreme Leader. That is a red line that would "open Pandora's box," as even Russian officials now warn.
2️⃣ Protect civilians. All sides must adhere to international law. No use of nuclear weapons, chemical weapons, or indiscriminate bombing.
3️⃣ Prevent regional spillover. Urge Gulf states, Turkey, Pakistan, India: do not let the fire spread. Do not be drawn in by vengeance or false pride.
4️⃣ Keep communication open. The U.S., Russia, and China must maintain emergency channels -- to prevent accidental escalation.
5️⃣ De-escalate tensions in South Asia, in the Balkans, and in East Asia -- even while war rages elsewhere.
**🌍**
**And what can ordinary people do?**
1️⃣ Stay informed -- but do not be paralyzed by doom. Understand the stakes, but also see the pathways that could lead away from war.
2️⃣ Speak out -- especially to political leaders. Wherever you are -- the U.S., Europe, Asia -- write, call, demand that leaders do not escalate recklessly. Remind them: nuclear war is not an option.
3️⃣ Resist propaganda that glorifies war. There are those who profit from endless conflict. Refuse their narratives. Demand diplomacy.
4️⃣ Support voices of restraint and peace -- across all divides. Jewish, Muslim, Christian, Hindu, atheist -- there is no religion or cause worth destroying the world for.
5️⃣ Build local resilience. In times of global crisis, strong local communities matter. Prepare, cooperate, support one another -- not in fear, but in readiness to face challenges together.
**History is watching us.**
If world leaders blunder into war now -- history will judge them as harshly as it judged the fools of 1914.
If instead they find the wisdom to step back -- to choose life over conquest -- then we may yet turn this moment toward a more stable future.
The hour is late. But we -- the people -- are not helpless.
Let us raise our voices, steady our minds, and do all we can to keep this fragile peace from shattering.

\- This tour went somewhere no one thought we’d reach - The Left’s strongholds are crumbling - This generation is choosing freedom - The comeback is happening — and YOU made it possible - This wasn’t just noise... - Packed crowds. Roaring students. The Left? Speechless. - We’re beating the Left. On their turf.

| | | [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtsxfg49w6st0rx0rplibdhckffkf80yrwn05at22ollc4e5s43uuw63u1xsviyv8ffajck95xaehp0gz0fv41sb3x4kc0jdko5p68y0oj3c5cwbkufkancryf58dcvdsbjun103p807efgkic75zl00aab8ad02t3v1o0du3xsvd1fvbp1w6n91p6prebfxr13g195791tbrkpmps5hzujg8v8yht1hidicq3d67uy6dlio6wcg9zqims97h6vfdtn&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sydjj1&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, I’ve written a lot of messages to patriots like you over the years... but never one quite like this. Because I’ve never had this much good news to share. And I’ve never felt this much urgency to say one thing: **THANK YOU.** I don’t know if you’ve ever felt something just... _shift..._ while it was happening... But this spring on the American Comeback Tour? **I did.** And if you were standing where I stood — listening to the crowd roar before I walked up to the “Prove Me Wrong” table at our Spring Finale at UC Riverside... You would’ve felt this generational shift in real time, too.
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtsxfg49w6st0rx0rplibdhckhnaznoexh0hpkmvt915ore9p8tpeugt1xoy1z8vj77wyzr4nc2bxtifkbgm47vj5mtio48soa3n2qwz6wt3tcwjljuwa3asdyb1avw6gt72rjmaoy5tt0mqxzo4sofakhf6hsgdjtr5mx80wqhwv4g6oj7hzqqekm8zuflgin0u5ixwz0vizbch6xniyofb2bl5dq479ncc33lnxf7q9xzo3f37tjpl97x5jw30j94&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sydjj1&__onlt=h)
---
You may have seen the photos from the tour... caught some of the videos... read about the chants of _“USA!”_ from students... But let me tell you exactly what happened this spring: **Patriots like you helped launch the most powerful Conservative campus tour in American history.** It was BOLD. It was LOUD. And it was PACKED... From beginning to end. **And the American Comeback Tour’s Spring FINALE was in a place no one thought we’d ever touch: California.** The same state where Leftist professors shut down free speech... where mobs scream in the faces of our students... where conservative ideas aren’t just unpopular — _they’re punishable offenses._ And yet... We filled the campus quad at UC Riverside. Students came early. Packed shoulder-to-shoulder. Ringing around the “Prove Me Wrong” tent to hear the truth. And when I walked on stage and said: “It’s okay to love America...” They ERUPTED.
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtsxfg49w6st0rx0rplibdhckifqtqake5ccy840i52mkcepmoh92tugx53dvpgwxwxsnvhltgsynyefmqh14pz56lgfk7v4d018kwvm07gsfcx61o76zhytis8gxowy88sywfx9o0md56bgmwt38czp92j526btphn995av18mxn7gf0tq74twwvq3h8k64pwj6mw1k0ly3ht4rlctjx6bviibazn6uxhwbe47t03exd7qo11rwc7p27kj3ljy831k&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sydjj1&__onlt=h)
---
It wasn’t just another great tour stop... **It was a BREAKTHROUGH.** Because this wasn’t the first stop in California this spring — it was the fourth IN MAY and the SIXTH of the tour. And each one was just as powerful... This wasn’t just another campus tour. _It was a line in the sand._ And every single time, the story was the same: The Left tried to dismiss us, hurl their obscenities, or shut us down... The students showed up anyway. And the truth rang out louder than ever before. _But let’s back up for a moment..._ Because while the California finale may have been the last stop of the Spring, this all started months ago. **Back in January, when we were laying out the calendar... These were the goals: Go BIGGER. Go BOLDER. Go DEEPER into Leftist territory.** We wanted to hit not just the battleground states... Not just the safe “Red” states... _But the ones the Left claimed as their own._ And then? We wanted to plant our flag. And because of patriots like you — that’s exactly what we did. **Let me give you the big picture:** ✅ 21 American Comeback Tour stops ✅ Overflow crowds with thousands of students ✅ Deep “Blue” states seeing young people rising up ✅ The Left rattled by a movement of young people who are rejecting them... _wholesale._ Students who had never once heard a Conservative speak in person... _finally heard one._ Students who were afraid to wear a cross or sport an American flag... _were loud, proud, and unashamed to stand for God and their country._ Students who were told they were alone... _realized they were part of something BIGGER than they ever imagined._ There are too many great stories, moments and pictures to pack into this one message... **But just look at what we're accomplishing:**
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtsxfg49w6st0rx0rplibdhckkn4nu14kssxgtjun13sx1et7t94os784agj14sx9jlo0sogzkgv1daey3he4vcp8b7dwmff5nl6gctifh7g5cxq2chezzwv19ezu5x1xlc6bbhgnqs0fp59lty214t1vm138iw6g97p7c51u1by3mhra1wuxwco4tl2l2opggfgr7unqkan38u0ehzkw0xqd3s7v88fkrqbt4ryqqpf8f5nk9djkto56c922n5r8fj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sydjj1&__onlt=h)
---
_Friend, this is why we fight..._ Not just for campus speeches. Not just for questions from students. **But for a generation-wide cultural reset — playing out in real time, in real places, in the hearts of real students.** This is why the American Comeback Tour matters. And I hope you know:**It wouldn’t exist without patriots like****YOU****.** Your support — your prayers, your belief in our students, your generous gifts — made all of this possible. Patriots like you put us on the road. You brought us onto these campuses. You sent us to the students who needed to hear our America First message the most. **You weren’t just watching this tour... You were powering it.** Now, let me be totally honest: _We’re not done. Not even close._ The American Comeback Tour may have just ended for the spring... But this summer? We’re preparing for something even BIGGER. We’re already mapping out new stops in the fall. New states. New targets in Leftist territory to break through. We’re building a plan to take this movement to the next level — to complete the cultural shift that started on this tour. To reach more students. To change more hearts and minds. **And raise up the boldest, most unapologetic generation of freedom-loving Americans since the founding of this country.** _I’m going to need you fighting alongside me, Friend._ Because now that we’ve tasted victory... now that we’ve seen what’s possible... We can’t back down. Not now. _Not ever._ Let’s keep building. Let’s keep pushing. Let’s keep GOING. The American Comeback is well underway. Let’s make sure it keeps rolling strong. **I can’t say “thank you” enough to the patriots like you who’ve helped make Turning Point USA the force it is today.** **Together, we’re SAVING America... one student at a time.**
---
For America, Charlie Kirk
Founder & CEO
Turning Point USA
---

**P.S.** I’ve been doing this for over a decade now, Friend... **_But I’ve never seen momentum like THIS._** These students are ready. They’re hungry for the truth and our ideas. This country is shifting — In a way you can genuinely FEEL. **And the Left is terrified.** You can see it in their mobs... The way they lash out at us and our students... But it’s not working anymore. **Because you and I are reaching the next generation — campus by campus, state by state, student by student.** **And that’s why I’m asking you to stand with us again today. Because every dollar you give today will be MATCHED.** That means your gift of $50 becomes $100... $100 becomes $200... And your impact? DOUBLED. _So, if you believe in this mission... If you’re proud of what we’re accomplishing... If you want to go even BIGGER this fall..._ Then this is your moment to step up and fuel what comes next. Let’s take the American Comeback Tour to every corner of this country when it returns this fall... Let’s train thousands of students this summer at our events to become the LEADERS we need for our America First movement... And let’s make sure the Left NEVER thinks they can own the hearts of America’s young people again. **[We’re not done. Let’s go DEFEAT the Left once and for all. Make your gift to Turning Point USA today and have your impact immediately DOUBLED.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtsxfg49w6st0rx0rplibdhcl1mvlabtn1ion1wt4f5dfzeb1c0gipvl7ep80xayyad3q9mx07you1sd9tjm4hifo3jyetr5jlh2z2r6t5kwfcxg5w90z7sxmii9ndxipu9mlut0m6cw5c05pnhlxi4q3a8lyo9xd0lx4h22ravzzsial5j5vd1hmbburmaifqz6aur26iebud96r600tap4rsj9n2pszv2ah4hj6lw880znecsar1mn48ik727fwp9&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sydjj1&__onlt=h)**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110174696/553510471/1034148403?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_GEN_TAN_AC_20250624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDliNTA5ZS0yZTUxLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zDUlGytdpBW_hOogU6Caul1yugzgNUmu60F2rxXK59A=) Folks, we’ve been talking with folks all across Colorado – at town halls, at community events, and as we go about our days – and one thing is abundantly clear: **People are just as frustrated as I am, and I bet you are too. Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are trying to rip health care away from millions and gut critical services Coloradans rely on.** The people of Colorado sent me to Washington to stand up for you and deliver real results. **So this is my promise to you: In this unprecedented and critical moment, we’re doing everything we can to fight back.** We’re challenging Trump and extreme Republicans’ radical plans – like their plan to cut Medicaid – and making sure everyone understands the pain they’re causing. Folks, I was raised to work hard and take care of my community.
Growing up, my family struggled to make ends meet. My mom immigrated from Mexico, and my dad worked double shifts as a construction worker. We depended on Medicaid, and when I lost my health insurance as a teenager, it nearly killed me.
**As the first in my family to attend college, I interned for then-Congresswoman Gabby Giffords. As a former nursing assistant, I was there to administer life-saving aid when she was shot in an act of political violence.**
That day changed my life forever. I witnessed firsthand the devastating effects of gun violence and vowed to use my voice and platform to prevent it.
_These hardships could have ended my career in public service before it even started, but instead, they fueled me to fight._
As a state legislator, I co-founded the LGBTQ caucus and fought to pass bills to protect gay marriage and survivors of sexual assault, increase gun violence prevention resources, and expand access to affordable healthcare.
**So I know a thing or two about getting sh*t done.**
Since gaining their MAGA trifecta, Republicans have done nothing but gut funding for essential programs like the Department of Education to line billionaires' pockets.
I'm running for Congress because I won't sit on the sidelines while they try to strip us of our rights and undermine our democracy.
Unlike most campaigns you're hearing from, **my race isn't in a year and a half - it’s just weeks away.** So we have an urgent opportunity to stop MAGA Republicans and stand up for our communities.

Growing up, my family struggled to make ends meet. My mom immigrated from Mexico, and my dad worked double shifts as a construction worker. We depended on Medicaid, and when I lost my health insurance as a teenager, it nearly killed me. As the first in my family to attend college, I interned for then-Congresswoman Gabby Giffords. As a former nursing assistant, I was there to administer life-saving aid when she was shot in an act of political violence. That day changed my life forever. I witnessed firsthand the devastating effects of gun violence and vowed to use my voice and platform to prevent it. These hardships could have ended my career in public service before it even started, but instead, they fueled me to fight. As a state legislator, I co-founded the LGBTQ caucus and fought to pass bills to protect gay marriage and survivors of sexual assault, increase gun violence prevention resources, and expand access to affordable healthcare. So I know a thing or two about getting sht done. Since gaining their MAGA trifecta, Republicans have done nothing but gut funding for essential programs like the Department of Education to line billionaires' pockets. I'm running for Congress because I won't sit on the sidelines while they try to strip us of our rights and undermine our democracy. Unlike most campaigns you're hearing from, my race isn't in a year and a half - it’s just weeks away. body:
Hey folks, John here.

It’s been three years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and stripped women of a fundamental freedom.

Let’s be clear: A woman’s right to make her own health care decisions is sacred and non-negotiable. Period.

Since Day One, I’ve fought like hell to protect abortion rights and make sure health care decisions stay where they belong – between a woman and her doctor. Not some suit in Washington.

I’m fighting to:

👉 Pass the Women’s Health Protection Act and protect the right to provide + receive abortion care.

👉 Let folks pick up a full year of birth control at once – because the government shouldn’t make that hard.

👉 Repeal the Hyde Amendment, which blocks low-income folks from accessing abortion care.

👉 Block Republicans’ latest dirty trick to defund Planned Parenthood by sneaking it into their budget bill.

They’re trying to shut down clinics, even in states where abortion is still legal. It’s disgusting, and it’s dangerous. I need your help to push back – hard.

Chip in now to help us hit our $15,000 goal before midnight. Let’s show these MAGA bullies that we’re not backing down.

Appreciate you,

John ❤️

| Today marks three years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , dismantling nearly 50 years of precedent and stripping away the constitutional right to abortion for millions of Americans.

Like so many of you, I was shocked, outraged – and determined to act.

In the years since, Republican-led legislatures across the country have passed laws that criminalize abortion, threaten doctors, and put deeply personal medical decisions in the hands of politicians. The results have been devastating, especially for women, trans and nonbinary people, and low-income communities.

As your representative, I was proud to cast the first pro-choice vote in West Michigan’s history. And I remain more committed than ever to protecting reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy for all.

But we know what it will take: We must retake the House to pass legislation that codifies the protections once guaranteed by _Roe v. Wade_.

[_**I hope you’ll stand with me in this fight. Your support – at any level – powers this campaign and this movement.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110175215/553512353/32658279?refcode=BLU_EM_HSC_2025-06-24_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODE1YzRlZS0zMDUxLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WcJAkziq6lhH8hgEsO7BoSN3DasuGt6xsJL5Ro2ceYw=)

body:
Today marks three years since the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade.

| Peter,

Today marks three years since the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.

The overturning of this landmark decision that protected abortion access as a constitutional right for decades had an immediate, devastating impact on millions of women, leaving them without access to reproductive health care.

And under the Republican trifecta, the attacks on reproductive health care have only gotten worse. While Medicaid funds for abortions have long been blocked, last month, Republicans passed a budget that included a ban on abortion providers like Planned Parenthood from receiving _any_ Medicaid funds for services like birth control, cancer screenings and STI treatment. This change could force Planned Parenthood centers across the country to close down since they would not be reimbursed for these essential services.

Republicans are also coming after the abortion pill mifepristone, which is used in 63% of all abortions in the US. Right now, in states with abortion bans, women can rely on telehealth providers to prescribe mifepristone through the first 10 weeks of pregnancy. But recently, HHS Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. asked the FDA to do a complete review based on junk science in an effort to further restrict access.

**These attacks are not just wrong, they are deadly. I strongly believe that women should have the right to make their own health care decisions without interference from politicians.**

That’s why I’m fighting every day to defend reproductive rights and protect access to care. But I can’t do it alone.

Peter, Today marks three years since the Dobbs decision -- the Supreme Court case that overturned Roe v. Wade, eliminating the federal constitutional right to abortion. Since that decision, there are now 28 states that have abortion bans and the GOP is not finished. Countless women's deaths could have been avoided and their blood is on their hands. A national abortion ban is coming, piece by piece.

And last night, the Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can resume deporting asylum seekers to third countries -- even places like Venezuela or Sudan -- regardless of whether it's their country of origin. The three liberal justices dissented, the **GOP majority didn 't even bother to offer an explanation for its ruling. **

These terrible decisions are the product of a **decades-long campaign by right-wing donors and extremists** to seize control of our courts, from the U.S. Supreme Court down to state supreme courts across the country. And they're not done yet -- _MAGA extremists have their eyes on Pennsylvania next._ This year, **three Democratic justices** on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court face retention. If the far-right succeeds in ousting them, it could tip the balance in one of the most critical swing states in the country. This is our chance to fight back. To protect voting rights, due process, and the rule of law. To stop the next wave of MAGA court-packing. _Defend Our Courts_ is leading the charge to retain Justices Donohue, Dougherty, and Wecht. But we need your help to take our message to voters before it's too late. Team, I have mixed feelings today. Today marks three years since The Supreme Court struck down federal protections for abortion in the infamous _Dobbs_ decision, which overturned _Roe v. Wade_. I remember exactly where I was when the ruling was announced. My father had passed away just the day before, and in a moment, my grief multiplied. I felt as though I had lost my father and my country in twenty-four hours, but I knew right away that I wasn’t the only one grieving. **I knew I had to turn those feelings into action, and that’s what I am continuing to do by running for office.** | [SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN TODAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110175789/553514136/954593249?source=RFX_JS_EM_FR_20250624_Dobbs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDcwMjAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjMzYmRiNmUtMzI1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=we9j4U6oCn1381IQgia-S1YQIVXqsofugrYOcX-gEgo=)

I’m running for Congress because healthcare decisions should be made between patients and their doctors, not by politicians.
I’m running for Congress to ensure everyone has unobstructed access to that care, regardless of zip code.
I’m running for Congress to make our country a place where women and girls, like my daughter, can grow up safe, healthy, and with opportunities to thrive.
My opponent **celebrated** the _Dobbs_ decision. He also supported a national abortion ban, supported anti-choice legislation so extreme it would even outlaw IVF treatment, and most recently, voted for disastrous cuts to Medicaid. Without IVF, I wouldn’t have been able to start my own family, nor would thousands of other American women.
He markets himself as a family man while defending the economic and healthcare barriers that make family planning more difficult. He’s one of the most radical anti-choice members of Congress, and **it’s well past time for new leadership for West and Southwest Michigan.**
So, to be fully transparent with you, I have a lot of mixed feelings. I grieve for the women who have lost their lives because state and federal governments have tied their doctors’ hands. I worry for the women who are still at risk for that reason. I miss my dad. I also have a hope and determination that, together, we have the power to put choice back in the hands of women.
Team, we need to work together to make an unflinchingly, unapologetically pro-choice Congress a reality. That starts by flipping the U.S. House, and I need your help to do that. clean_body: It’s been three years since the Dobbs decision. | | = Team, I have mixed feelings today. Today marks three years since The Supreme Court struck down federal protections for abortion in the infamous Dobbs decision, which overturned Roe v. Wade. I remember exactly where I was when the ruling was announced. My father had passed away just the day before, and in a moment, my grief multiplied. I felt as though I had lost my father and my country in twenty-four hours, but I knew right away that I wasn’t the only one grieving. I knew I had to turn those feelings into action, and that’s what I am continuing to do by running for office. | = I’m running for Congress because healthcare decisions should be made between patients and their doctors, not by politicians. I’m running for Congress to ensure everyone has unobstructed access to that care, regardless of zip code. I’m running for Congress to make our country a place where women and girls, like my daughter, can grow up safe, healthy, and with opportunities to thrive. My opponent celebrated the Dobbs decision. He also supported a national abortion ban, supported anti-choice legislation so extreme it would even outlaw IVF treatment, and most recently, voted for disastrous cuts to Medicaid. Without IVF, I wouldn’t have been able to start my own family, nor would thousands of other American women. He markets himself as a family man while defending the economic and healthcare barriers that make family planning more difficult. He’s one of the most radical anti-choice members of Congress, and it’s well past time for new leadership for West and Southwest Michigan. So, to be fully transparent with you, I have a lot of mixed feelings. I grieve for the women who have lost their lives because state and federal governments have tied their doctors’ hands. I worry for the women who are still at risk for that reason. I miss my dad. I also have a hope and determination that, together, we have the power to put choice back in the hands of women. Team, we need to work together to make an unflinchingly, unapologetically pro-choice Congress a reality. | | Dear Peter,
---
Thanks to your incredible support—we did it! Save the Redwoods League is thrilled to **[announce](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110176301/553515861/1070264243?sourceid=1166936&utm_campaign=monterio&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-announcements&ms=MR2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1NzQxNDg3LTM0NTEtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_PFEXyxZIm5reJHus3pSjFmXlhmAlCjLJTbqwWAdpYs=&emci=69dd2d08-6a50-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=c5741487-3451-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551 "The Monte Rio Redwoods expansion is complete!")** that we’ve purchased the 1,517-acre **[Monte Rio Redwoods Expansion](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110176302/553515862/-435492268?sourceid=1166936&utm_campaign=monterio&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-announcements&ms=MR2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1NzQxNDg3LTM0NTEtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_PFEXyxZIm5reJHus3pSjFmXlhmAlCjLJTbqwWAdpYs=&emci=69dd2d08-6a50-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=c5741487-3451-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551)** property and transferred it to Sonoma County Regional Parks for ongoing stewardship and public access. **This is a major win for redwoods, people, and the planet.**
---
| | We’re proud to have worked hand in hand with Sonoma County Regional Parks and the Sonoma County Ag + Open Space District to make this milestone a reality.
---
---
We are deeply grateful to our key fundraising partners. The $24 million needed to secure the incredible Monte Rio property was generously provided by the California Wildlife Conservation Board, Sonoma County Ag + Open Space, the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation, Sonoma Land Trust, the Federated Indians of Graton Rancheria, and an anonymous West Sonoma County family. And of course, **thousands of individual donors like you**. Thank you! **Here’s why this land matters so much: **
---
| |
* The purchase snaps the final puzzle piece into place, solidifying a vast, connected expanse of more than 34 square miles of redwoods, meadows, and streams, between Sonoma Coast State Park and Monte Rio Redwoods Regional Park.

* It fills a key gap in a vital wildlife corridor stretching along the coastal mountains from Marin County to Mendocino County.

* It contains nearly four miles of Russian River tributary streams that provide critical spawning habitat for threatened coho salmon and steelhead trout.

* It offers a chance to restore both the ecological health and cultural significance of the traditional lands of the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians and the Southern Pomo group of the Federated Indians of Graton Rancheria.

---
---
Because of you, this incredible redwood forest is now public land. We’re honored to have achieved this milestone together, and we simply couldn’t do this work without your continued support.

Because of you, this incredible redwood forest is now public land. We’re honored to have achieved this milestone together, and we simply couldn’t do this work without your continued support. name: Wes Moore
subject: Uplifting our federal workers
body:
To continue making good progress, we need to understand what is in our control.
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=216%2E1086043%2EKe7-ow)
Peter,
We’ve got to focus on what we can control, and right now, that means standing with the people who make government work.
In Maryland, we’re home to more than 260,000 federal workers. These are folks who wake up every day and serve our country with dignity.
Now, they’re afraid of losing their jobs thanks to reckless decisions coming from the White House that put political theater over people’s livelihoods.
While the president is arbitrarily firing federal workers, we’re taking action to help impacted public servants land on their feet.
We’re building partnerships to connect them with new career opportunities in both the state and federal sectors as part of our effort to leave no one behind. We expanded the Maryland Public Servants Resource Website, streamlined the process for displaced workers to be recruited and hired, and announced recruiting initiatives and hiring fairs.
**[Peter, our goal is to uplift workers while the federal government tries to push them down. If you believe in our mission, add your name now to stand with the workers who keep this country running.](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/stand-federal-workers/?source=em-20250624-1&akid=216%2E1086043%2EKe7-ow)**

Patriot,

If you were wondering how I ended up in a wheelchair, the story goes back just over 40 years. When I was 26 years old, a massive tree fell on me while I was out for a jog.

In an instant, my back was broken, and I was left paralyzed from the waist down.
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=ce2b4d006c3d43e892e8700ce0ea5e8a&_e=szQjgn1qBihLJ_2po_btFwHCcIJWfAwksRJDuNLG_bbkmgjmkRTMVKHYjudI3ehF-dl-8EAicGI0-hWHYehwHOa3icsjX-G4PH5WSbckIj9EM-e-IxmpvxtPAKDRTAwuCyC2Z54Mh1G20v-evPfas2qs-JLMR3Oq7HEy2C-Ab5OPJY1zbVTgYWXHYm2-Lu8rX7JFpKXezaL4dL3GOC-V_xBHhCA5aADe_im6_1_g5ZqZaaGl8FzkEVpbbgijVdGRN7Qvs7SHWZx-v5Vyya3dRCRBwzTYD-26oFEYwbifIIiCTlDS-5gsZ8Tc2sUgoEKTf0bP1kbSh_5-AaF0tWjhTDUEJ1jGV3hC6ElrTaSLWrG0eNt9cDSB1oDo1HD0gEJjTxsnNbhBtqm2fXK2pA3Yq5DUPJhiDtcBjuUz3gRb0E52QsW9YtoG_zg5Ph9drzco4OvkKBqrF3sqgkbaSP8qvvGoJ0JZHsf-npexiTWSOUCFB20ceXwpygsBNLLoqxM60uwQm6ZBSqt19X32hpGXHhXaMX59ZBVjVKDNuMT9pVFFv33kGTPZQf8XlTZDpiAG1X7X73hArw9_m2CnjIrJJTpRiNgIhAisd80kTzZocCkQhd6mXBOL4T6CEkUOu3-fNC8mIuwBHXcx-dwK4nEwN_Io6etPDJ8I3bXjEBMLSvITWXaj_ZqjW_O5qmc5_Fsr)
Doctors told me I'd never walk again. But, that didn't stop me.

Through months of grueling rehab, and with the support of my family, faith, and steel rods in my spine, I learned how to keep moving forward.

My accident didn't end my life. It defined it. It taught me how to fight through pain. How to endure. How to lead.

It drove me throughout my legal career and service to Texas as Attorney General and a Supreme Court Justice.

That same spirit is what drives how I lead Texas today as Governor.

Right now, we face a challenge that requires every ounce of the same determination, and I'm asking for your help to overcome it:

**The fundraising freeze for Texas lawmakers just lifted and we now have just days before our first fundraising report of the cycle is filed for all to see.**

That's the shortest window in modern history to show the strength of our conservative movement before the numbers go public, which is why I'm asking for your support in a BIG way.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Untitled Document Patriot, If you were wondering how I ended up in a wheelchair, the story goes back just over 40 years. When I was 26 years old, a massive tree fell on me while I was out for a jog. In an instant, my back was broken, and I was left paralyzed from the waist down. Doctors told me I'd never walk again. But, that didn't stop me. Through months of grueling rehab, and with the support of my family, faith, and steel rods in my spine, I learned how to keep moving forward. My accident didn't end my life. It defined it. It taught me how to fight through pain. How to endure. How to lead. It drove me throughout my legal career and service to Texas as Attorney General and a Supreme Court Justice. That same spirit is what drives how I lead Texas today as Governor. Right now, we face a challenge that requires every ounce of the same determination, and I'm asking for your help to overcome it: The fundraising freeze for Texas lawmakers just lifted and we now have just days before our first fundraising report of the cycle is filed for all to see. That's the shortest window in modern history to show the strength of our conservative movement before the numbers go public, which is why I'm asking for your support in a BIG way. Dear Peter,

I’ve spent my life fighting for Wyoming — because this is my home. I was born and raised on a cattle ranch in Laramie County, and my roots here run deep.

I know what it means to work hard, live free, and take pride in where you come from. That’s the Wyoming way — and it’s exactly what I’ve taken with me to Washington.

From my years in the State Legislature to serving as your U.S. Senator, I’ve never stopped fighting to protect the values that make Wyoming strong and America great.

**Whether it’s securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, or creating good-paying jobs, I’ve always put Wyoming and America first.**

As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a member of the conservative Senate Steering Committee, I pushed back against the Biden administration’s extreme agenda — especially when it came to reckless spending, anti-energy mandates, and efforts to lock up our lands.

I’ve fought to protect our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries, because I know how vital they are — not just to Wyoming’s economy, but to America’s future.

This year, I’ve also been fighting to cut red tape, secure our border, and lead on crypto policy that protects innovation and freedom. **I’m in the Senate to make Washington work for Wyoming — _not the other way around._**

_But now, our work is under serious threat._

**Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026.** They know that without the Senate, they can’t ram through their radical agenda.

That’s why they’re pouring money into races across the country — including right here in the West — trying to tip the balance of power in their favor.

**_We can’t let that happen._**

clean_body: Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026. | Dear Peter, I’ve spent my life fighting for Wyoming — because this is my home. I was born and raised on a cattle ranch in Laramie County, and my roots here run deep. I know what it means to work hard, live free, and take pride in where you come from. That’s the Wyoming way — and it’s exactly what I’ve taken with me to Washington. From my years in the State Legislature to serving as your U.S. Senator, I’ve never stopped fighting to protect the values that make Wyoming strong and America great. Whether it’s securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, or creating good-paying jobs, I’ve always put Wyoming and America first. As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a member of the conservative Senate Steering Committee, I pushed back against the Biden administration’s extreme agenda — especially when it came to reckless spending, anti-energy mandates, and efforts to lock up our lands. I’ve fought to protect our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries, because I know how vital they are — not just to Wyoming’s economy, but to America’s future. This year, I’ve also been fighting to cut red tape, secure our border, and lead on crypto policy that protects innovation and freedom. I’m in the Senate to make Washington work for Wyoming — not the other way around. But now, our work is under serious threat. Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026. They know that without the Senate, they can’t ram through their radical agenda. That’s why they’re pouring money into races across the country — including right here in the West — trying to tip the balance of power in their favor. We can’t let that happen. If we lose our Senate majority, we lose the ability to block dangerous policies and stand up for the freedoms we hold dear. Will you chip in to help us hold the line and defend our Senate majority? | I’m not in this fight for headlines or personal gain.
