| **Rob Schneider Endorses Karrin Taylor Robson for Governor of Arizona** _Actor, comedian, and outspoken conservative Rob Schneider joins the growing movement behind Robson’s campaign._
**PHOENIX, AZ** – Karrin Taylor Robson, Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor of Arizona, announced today the endorsement of Rob Schneider, a nationally recognized actor, comedian, and conservative activist. Known for his outspoken defense of free speech, individual liberty, and traditional values, Schneider’s endorsement highlights Karrin’s growing support from Americans who are ready to restore common sense in government and take back Arizona from the radical left.
“ARIZONA NEEDS A NEW GOVERNOR! I am voting for KARRIN ROBSON!!” Schneider declared.
Karrin Taylor Robson welcomed the endorsement, saying:
“Rob Schneider has risked his career to stand up for what is right. He stood up to the woke mob and has never backed down from defending American values. I’m proud to have him on our team as we fight to restore common sense and conservative leadership to Arizona.”

body:
#

Hi, it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Senator Elizabeth Warren.
As I write this, Senate Republicans are preparing to force a vote on Donald Trump’s “big, beautiful bill” _this week_. And it includes the provision to make it easier to obtain gun silencers.
The only people who will benefit from this are criminals and the corporations selling these devices. **It’s shameful, which is why we must raise our voices right now.**
[**I hope you will read Senator Elizabeth Warren’s message, then rush a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue this work today. We cannot stay silent.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250624-1-b&t=1&akid=10610%2E3935704%2EB6ZcoX)

_\---------- Begin forwarded message ---------
From: Elizabeth Warren
Subject I have an urgent update you need to hear.
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com _
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250624-1-b&t=2&akid=10610%2E3935704%2EB6ZcoX)
---
Hi team -- Elizabeth Warren here, reaching out on behalf of my friend Gabby Giffords. I have an urgent Senate update you need to hear.
Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans just included a provision in their “big beautiful bill” that would make it easier to buy dangerous gun silencers. Victims of mass shootings wouldn’t even hear their attacker.
This is sickening. And it’s a massive gift to the gun lobby at the expense of public safety. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today.
[**GIFFORDS is fighting on the front lines to stop this provision, and they could use more grassroots donations to stand up against the Trump administration. Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS right now?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250624-1-b&t=3&akid=10610%2E3935704%2EB6ZcoX)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250624-1-b&t=4&akid=10610%2E3935704%2EB6ZcoX)**
Gun silencers make it harder for police to track shootings because they can’t figure out where the shots are coming from. Having even more silencers flood into our communities will only make us less safe. It’s common sense.
**But it’s clear Donald Trump and Republicans do not care. The only thing they want is to give tax breaks to their gun CEO buddies and help them profit even more.**
We are still debating this bill in the Senate right now, so you can bet that I will continue raising hell to remove this section from the bill. But I cannot take on this fight alone.
[**Will you make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS before midnight? We cannot sit back while Donald Trump and Republicans try to turn back the clock on our progress.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250624-1-b&t=5&akid=10610%2E3935704%2EB6ZcoX)

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Donald Trump’s Super PAC just jumped into our race.
body:
|
#
Folks, **This is serious: Donald Trump’s Super PAC just jumped into our race.** That brings the total Republican outside spending in MI-08 to nearly**$800,000** – all aimed at replacing me with someone who will rubber-stamp the MAGA agenda. And here’s what they’re spending that money on: lies. Their latest attack ad falsely claims I voted to raise taxes on working families and hand out tax breaks to billionaire sports team owners. **It’s a complete fabrication.** Here’s the truth: I voted _against_ giving tax cuts to billionaires – because I believe working families in mid-Michigan shouldn’t be footing the bill while the ultra-wealthy get special breaks. In fact, I led the effort to pass the biggest tax cut for working families in Michigan’s history! | Just picture Trump’s face when he hears that two lesbian women have been elected to the U.S. Senate.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4774%2E35263%2EKLMyDZ)
Peter, it’s Senator Tammy Baldwin, and I have an important announcement:
**I’m proud to endorse Angie Craig — my friend and fellow Midwesterner — to represent Minnesota in the U.S. Senate.[Can I count on you to split $5 to support Angie in this toss-up race?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2256?c0=stb-em-craig.6VNtqL&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20250624_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4774%2E35263%2EKLMyDZ)**
[DONATE NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4438?c0=stb-em-craig.VHzI8K&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20250624_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4774%2E35263%2EKLMyDZ)
---
When I became the first openly gay U.S. Senator elected in our nation’s history, I felt the weight of that responsibility. I wanted to make a difference in people’s lives — and I wanted to be an unapologetic advocate for the LGBTQ+ community.
Now, over a decade later, we have the chance to make history again and give LGBTQ+ folks another champion in the U.S. Senate. Angie would be the first lesbian mom _ever_ elected to the U.S. Senate and the _first_ LGBTQ+ U.S. Senator in Minnesota history. It’s about time, right? 🏳️🌈
In Congress, Angie has made it her mission to take on Big Pharma and lower prescription drug prices, protect marriage equality through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , stand up to corporate monopolies that are jacking up costs and go to bat for working families.
Now, with Donald Trump back in the White House and the GOP in the majority, the challenges we’re facing are greater than ever. Republicans have introduced or passed nearly 600 bills _just this year_ that roll back rights and protections for LGBTQ+ folks.
To make matters worse, Trump and his right-wing allies are trying to take a sledgehammer to our health care, our Social Security and Medicare, our jobs and our fundamental rights.
**Trump will do everything in his power to push forward this dangerous agenda — including using his $600 million war chest to target and defeat Democrats like Angie.**

**Boysko Bulletin: Third Anniversary of the Dobbs Decision; Vote This Week to Fill the CD 11 Seat
**
---
Dear Peter, Today marks the 3rd anniversary of the U.S. Supreme Court Dobb’s decision which removes the fundamental right to abortion. It was the first time in my life that a U.S. Constitutional right has been removed. With regulation left to the states, abortion bans and restrictions have been enacted in many states throughout the country, resulting in a deepening of racial and economic injustices in our healthcare system. We have seen the refusal to treat pregnant people who are seeking lifesaving miscarriage and ectopic pregnancy care, delays while doctors consult with their lawyers, and women suffering and dying. I am proud to be the chief patron of Virginia’s Constitutional Amendment to enshrine the full scope of reproductive rights into our Commonwealth's constitution, protecting the right to contraception, fertility care, miscarriage care, and abortion. I was honored to be named as Legislator of the Year by REPRORising for my efforts to protect the right to make these most personal decisions for ourselves. Following the recent violence in Minnesota where two State Senators were shot along with their spouses in their homes \- one senator and her husband murdered- we stay determined, we will not be intimidated by threats or violence. With your help, we will win a pro-choice House of Delegates, pass the Constitutional Amendment for the second time as required, and then it will go before the public for you, the voters, to have your say in the fall of 2026. I ask you to stand with me to denounce all acts of intimidation and violence by the tiny minority of people who are willing to harm abortion rights activists, medical providers, legislators and our families. This week, we are voting to fill Congressman Connolly’s seat in a firehouse caucus primary. I will be voting for James Walkinshaw. James served Congressman Connolly for a decade then went on to become the Fairfax County Supervisor where he currently serves the Braddock District. He will stand up and fight for us as Gerry always did. I urge you to cast your vote for him too. Governor Youngkin set the special election for September 9. Democrats are voting this week and Republicans are voting on Saturday. There is more information below. I encourage you to take action to stay safe during the extreme heat we are facing this week. You will find the latest forecasts on the [National Weather Service website](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180308/553530148/-2037048300?lat=38.977642&lon=-77.384055&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODhlN2QyZTctM2U1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KOsLr4seYkTg24bslP8xoypRJEaBkGRQHPFpVd7bkSw=&emci=9b7a225c-8050-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=88e7d2e7-3e51-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=22486556). In response to the extreme heat watch, Fairfax County has activated its Heat Plan which includes cooling centers around the county which are available during normal operating hours for individuals needing relief from the heat. These cooling centers will have supplies available including bottled water, sunscreen, insect repellant, and body wipes. Fairfax County also distributes supplies through outreach workers and other partners who go out into the community to check on unsheltered residents, and they are also available at shelters, drop-in centers, and meal sites. Learn more [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180326/553530166/291269083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODhlN2QyZTctM2U1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KOsLr4seYkTg24bslP8xoypRJEaBkGRQHPFpVd7bkSw=&emci=9b7a225c-8050-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=88e7d2e7-3e51-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=22486556). Stay cool! Kindest regards,

You can download MetroPulse, a new mobile app that allows customers to plan trips, chat with customer service, report issues on the system, and more. Features include real-time bus and train location and arrival information, a trip planner, Metro customer service chat, ability to report issues on the system, and bus and rail maps. MetroPulse is now available in the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store. Real-time service information is also available on X at @metrorailinfo and @metrobusinfo, and on Bluesky at @metrorailinfo.bsky.social, and @metrobusinfo. For service alerts via text or email, sign up for MetroAlerts. **Proof of Citizenship Now Required to Board Domestic Flights and Enter Federal Facilities**
---
---
The federal government now requires that you present a REAL ID-compliant form of identification to board a domestic flight or to enter a secure federal facility or military base. A REAL ID is an optional, upgraded version of your driver’s license or ID card with a star in the right corner. Since REAL ID is optional in Virginia, you may not need one if you already have another federally accepted form of ID, like a valid U.S. passport or military ID, or don’t travel by plane. However, if you do want one, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Constituents have reached out concerned about the time it takes for DMV to verify citizenship. If you need assistance, please reach out by email at SenatorBoysko@senate.virginia.gov. DMV’s website has clear [instructions for REAL ID applicants](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180332/553530173/106817674?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODhlN2QyZTctM2U1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KOsLr4seYkTg24bslP8xoypRJEaBkGRQHPFpVd7bkSw=&emci=9b7a225c-8050-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=88e7d2e7-3e51-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=22486556). **Election Updates** **Congressional District 11 to Select Candidates for the September 9th Special Election ** The special election for Virginia's 11th district will be September 9th, 2025. The Virginia Democratic Primary for this seat will be a firehouse primary (meaning it is run by the political party). It will be held on Saturday June 28th, 2025 from 7am to 7pm. Early voting will be available from Tuesday June 24th to Thursday June 26th from 3pm to 8pm. Early voting will only be available at the Fairfax County Government Center, 12000 Government Center Pkwy in Fairfax. Working together, we can build good lives for our families and our communities. The news of deportations is distressing and we can prepare. **If you or a loved one encounter immigration enforcement officials, it is essential that you know your rights and have prepared your household for all possible outcomes** : **Ask for a warrant** : The Fourth Amendment of the Constitution protects you from unreasonable search and seizure. You do not have to open your door until you see a valid warrant to enter your home or search your belongings. **You have the right to remain silent** : The Fifth Amendment protects your right to remain silent and not incriminate yourself. You are not required to share any personal information such as your place of birth, immigration status or criminal history. Respectfully say, “I am exercising my right to remain silent.” **Always consult an attorney** : You have a right to speak with an attorney. You do not have to sign anything or hand officials any documents without speaking to an attorney. Try to identify and consult one in advance. Please share this information from the ACLU, available in multiple languages: [“Know Your Rights.”](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180382/553530223/-939671523?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODhlN2QyZTctM2U1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KOsLr4seYkTg24bslP8xoypRJEaBkGRQHPFpVd7bkSw=&emci=9b7a225c-8050-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=88e7d2e7-3e51-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=22486556) We are also working with the Legal Aid Justice Center which has asked that we share their [Rapid Response Toolkit](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180383/553530224/1464008473?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODhlN2QyZTctM2U1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KOsLr4seYkTg24bslP8xoypRJEaBkGRQHPFpVd7bkSw=&emci=9b7a225c-8050-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=88e7d2e7-3e51-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=22486556). clean_body: | | | Boysko Bulletin: Third Anniversary of the Dobbs Decision; Vote This Week to Fill the CD 11 Seat Dear Peter, Today marks the 3rd anniversary of the U.S. Supreme Court Dobb’s decision which removes the fundamental right to abortion. It was the first time in my life that a U.S. Constitutional right has been removed. With regulation left to the states, abortion bans and restrictions have been enacted in many states throughout the country, resulting in a deepening of racial and economic injustices in our healthcare system. We have seen the refusal to treat pregnant people who are seeking lifesaving miscarriage and ectopic pregnancy care, delays while doctors consult with their lawyers, and women suffering and dying. I am proud to be the chief patron of Virginia’s Constitutional Amendment to enshrine the full scope of reproductive rights into our Commonwealth's constitution, protecting the right to contraception, fertility care, miscarriage care, and abortion. I was honored to be named as Legislator of the Year by REPRORising for my efforts to protect the right to make these most personal decisions for ourselves. Following the recent violence in Minnesota where two State Senators were shot along with their spouses in their homes \- one senator and her husband murdered- we stay determined, we will not be intimidated by threats or violence. With your help, we will win a pro-choice House of Delegates, pass the Constitutional Amendment for the second time as required, and then it will go before the public for you, the voters, to have your say in the fall of 2026. I ask you to stand with me to denounce all acts of intimidation and violence by the tiny minority of people who are willing to harm abortion rights activists, medical providers, legislators and our families. This week, we are voting to fill Congressman Connolly’s seat in a firehouse caucus primary. I will be voting for James Walkinshaw. James served Congressman Connolly for a decade then went on to become the Fairfax County Supervisor where he currently serves the Braddock District. He will stand up and fight for us as Gerry always did. I urge you to cast your vote for him too. Governor Youngkin set the special election for September 9. Democrats are voting this week and Republicans are voting on Saturday. There is more information below. I encourage you to take action to stay safe during the extreme heat we are facing this week. You will find the latest forecasts on the . In response to the extreme heat watch, Fairfax County has activated its Heat Plan which includes cooling centers around the county which are available during normal operating hours for individuals needing relief from the heat. These cooling centers will have supplies available including bottled water, sunscreen, insect repellant, and body wipes. Fairfax County also distributes supplies through outreach workers and other partners who go out into the community to check on unsheltered residents, and they are also available at shelters, drop-in centers, and meal sites. Learn more . Stay cool! Kindest regards, Jennifer B. Know Your Rights - Resources for Immigrants I will continue to work to ensure that our communities are welcoming, diverse and provide opportunities for all people to live with dignity and safety. Working together, we can build good lives for our families and our communities. The news of deportations is distressing and we can prepare. If you or a loved one encounter immigration enforcement officials, it is essential that you know your rights and have prepared your household for all possible outcomes : Ask for a warrant : The Fourth Amendment of the Constitution protects you from unreasonable search and seizure. You do not have to open your door until you see a valid warrant to enter your home or search your belongings. You have the right to remain silent : The Fifth Amendment protects your right to remain silent and not incriminate yourself. You are not required to share any personal information such as your place of birth, immigration status or criminal history. Respectfully say, “I am exercising my right to remain silent.” Always consult an attorney : You have a right to speak with an attorney. You do not have to sign anything or hand officials any documents without speaking to an attorney. Try to identify and consult one in advance. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. | | Hi Friend,

I just wanted to make sure you saw Reagan's message from last week. Team Dunn is out in force all over our community making sure that King County voters know Reagan is our last line of defense against extreme tax hikes, the defunding of law enforcement, and radical downtown Seattle policies. But we need your help!

We will be walking in parades in Enumclaw on July 4th and Covington on July 19th and we'd love for you to join us! (**[Sign up to walk with Team Dunn in an upcoming parade!](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=a5c55d252b&e=77eef70c61))**

However, reaching voters costs money. Door-knocking literature, parade materials, signs, and advertising all have costs. **Would you be willing to[make a quick $15 or $25 donation](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=eb0ce998ec&e=77eef70c61) to help our campaign?**

Just $15 could help us sponsor a volunteer's lunch, purchase 35 door-knocking pieces of literature, or mail 20 voters. **[Help us pay for campaign materials to reach voters by making a donation today! ](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=15ff9030b9&e=77eef70c61)**
With your help, we will ensure that King County doesn't lose its voice of reason and defense against extreme tax hikes. Thank you!!

Team Dunn

From: **Reagan Dunn** <info@reagandunn.com>
Date: Sun, Jun 15, 2025 at 4:03 PM
Subject: Parade season is here!

Friends,

If you've watched the news recently, it may seem like there's a never-ending parade of new taxes being proposed and passed by politicians in Olympia and Seattle. I'm running to fight against these extreme tax hikes that increase the cost of living and harm everyday folks.

With budgets tight, people often tell me, "I would love to help the campaign, but it's hard to give money right now." I understand this, and I have great news--Parade season is starting! An easy and fun way to help me fight against extreme tax hikes is to join me and my team in walking the Enumclaw and Covington parades. **[Sign up to walk with Team Dunn in an upcoming parade!](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=43f302ceff&e=77eef70c61)** [](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=f26d1692bc&e=77eef70c61)
The Enumclaw Parade is on July 4th at 12 p.m., and the Covington Parade is on July 19th at 10 a.m. **_[Let me know if you can join us by signing up at this link!](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=aa0e7fa9c9&e=77eef70c61)_**

While politicians in Seattle and Olympia introduce their own parade of tax increases, we'll counter with a joyful parade walk--letting them know our campaign is the last line of defense against irresponsible tax hikes!

Thanks for all your help, and let me know if you can make it!
Reagan Dunn

Can't make either parade but still want to help? _[Sponsor a volunteer for $10](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=306b978994&e=77eef70c61) to help us buy lunches and water for them! **[DONATE HERE](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=faf297b40a&e=77eef70c61)!**_

Nellie Pou is in a tough spot, guys. She’s one of the very few Democrats who won in a Trump district. That makes her seat absolutely critical to winning a Democratic majority in 2026. If you’ve got her back, **[can you contribute $5 here?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110180600/553530908/-200729754?amount=5amp;&refcode=250624_mc_kicker_l1&ms=250624_mc_kicker&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTU0MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZThlYzRlMDQtNDA1MS1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=k-EFBau0HPLC-0FVo1uD7YqjjJCOh4d-Zq01m8mgEdE=)** And the pressure on her is intense. But Nellie is doing the hard work of bringing people together — standing firm with Democrats on the issues that matter, while reaching across the aisle to deliver real results for her district. ✅ Fighting to protect Medicare and Medicaid

Donald Trump has a new enemy.
Nope. It's not the Iranians. He bombed them. "Totally obliterated" three nuclear facilities inside that Middle Eastern Country on Saturday, at least according to him, so he's moving on.
His latest enemy? A fellow Republican. Congressman Thomas Massie has drawn Trump's ire because Massie had the audacity to disagree with Trump bombing Iran.
Massie is a Kentucky member of MAGA. Among the reasons he's supported Trump in the past was because of Trumps vehement anti-war stance. He agreed with Trump's statements about all wars being "stupid" so he, along with others on the Right were "appalled" to find Trump authorized bombing Iran Saturday when we were weren't at war with Iran.
"I'll concede it was a good week for the neocons who want war all the time," he said on NBC. "I wouldn't call my side of the MAGA base isolationists, we're exhausted, we're tired from all of these wars. This was one of the promises of his campaign. He promised we would put America first."
He even doubled down with a post on "X". "When two countries are bombing each other daily in a hot war, and a third country joins the bombing, that's an act of war. I'm amazed at the mental gymnastics being undertaken by neocons in DC (and their social media bots) to say we aren't at war ... so they can make war."
This rare criticism so unraveled Don the Con that he unloaded on Massie with a posting on his Truth Social account:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70b4493c-26d1-46fb-8341-19e79b638184?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/12beda2c-0902-4852-8f0b-22d7ac215c26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Thank you for your attention to the matter? He also sounds like a bill collector.
And Trump even had less energy on Sunday for Iran, merely saying he was cheering regime change in Iran - "Let's Make Iran Great Again." MIRA . . .
However some members of MAGA echoed Massie, "We're supposed to make America great again, not Iran."
Adding insult to injury, Trump himself has repeatedly disparaged the violence he just unleashed on Iran, "No country in the world could do what we did," he said. But, he has criticized former presidents for considering such actions in the past. Here's a tweet that didn't age well
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4d1befbf-2114-4ada-a03e-06e93c87a861?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

It is still unclear what violence will be visited on America due to Trump's actions, but the Iranians threatened Sunday to close the Strait of Hormuz, which is used to transport crude oil around the globe - thus at the very least almost guaranteeing a rise in prices at the gas pump.
Add that to the list of broken promises by Trump which includes, but is not limited to: No new wars, The Big Beautiful Wall, "A wall like no one has seen before," the end of the Russian/Ukraine war and cheaper eggs.
The fear, of course, is not with the Iranian military. The Israelis apparently destroyed the Iranian air capability and according to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth the American military was thus able to send 125 aircraft, 14 "bunker busters" into Iran and back without a spitball being fired at them. The U.S. Navy pumped in two dozen tomahawk missiles for good measure, plus a partridge in a pear tree.
Vice President JD Vance, who stared strangely [which in his defense, is the only way he knows how] at Trump as the president announced that the U.S. military had completely "obliterated" and devastated the Iranian ability to enrich uranium.
He said on Meet the Press Sunday, "I feel confident that we've substantially delayed their development of a nuclear weapon. . . I'm not going to get into sensitive intelligence here, but I think that we have really pushed their program back by a very long time."
What a week? Two? There's no telling. And we simply have to wait until satellite photos and other instruments are used, including verification on the ground to be sure how badly we hobbled the Iranian effort to enrich uranium.
We certainly seem to have encouraged them at this point, a fact that Democratic Senator Adam Schiff mentioned on CNN. "We simply don't know what is going to occur-- whether Iran will retaliate, whether Iran was able to evacuate some of the enriched material. There were commercial satellite images of trucks lined up at Fordo and leaving in the days preceding the strike."
If that seems vague, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard posted on social media, "Now the war has begun for us."
Former President Bill Clinton chimed in and said this has been Benjamin Netanyahu's goal for a while - a war with Iran to make sure he isn't removed from office and prosecuted for crimes. If that sounds familiar, it's only because that's why Trump ran for office in 2024.
Trump is simply gambling his entire presidency and our lives on his success in bombing Iran. He kind of sounds like Superfly;
_" Taking all that he can take
Gambling with the odds of fate
Tryin' to get over
Tryin' to get over
Tryin' to get over
Tryin' to get over"_
Trump doesn't have that cool theme song, but he does have Bibi, and they make a "great team" perhaps the "best team ever" according to him.
But there is a real concern about what comes next. A former senior White House national security expert from the Biden administration told me Sunday, "We have to be willing to wait to see the results before jumping to conclusions. Iran without enrichment facilities is not a bad thing for the region and for us. I'm shedding no tears for the damage done to Iran's program. No one should," the source explained.
"That said, it is clear that Trump got 'double-dog-dared' into this by BiBi and Fox News. And now we're in it. So, they need to define success in this conflict and what they are prepared to do should Iran retaliate.
The good news is that well before these strikes were launched, Iran was already much weaker than they had been in the past. So itis not clear if or how will be able to retaliate. My concern is that Trump rushed into this and hasn't thought that through." Well, wouldn't that be unusual.
Hence, that is everyone's concern at this point. "In many ways this is the result of Trump's walking away from the Obama accords," former Obama State Department Official Joel Rubin explained Sunday on ["Just Ask the Question".](https://substack.com/redirect/533aa4cf-ca38-459b-ac7b-ea1a7c5de653?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Terrorist attacks on the United States mainland cannot be discounted, and Rubin said that part of the reason for that is because Trump has "gutted the FBI, USAID," and has ICE raiding Home Depots in Southern California trying to round up 3,000 undocumented workers per week. Apparently, a Stephen Miller obsession is more important than preventing an attack on the homeland.
"The FBI is our front line defenders in this battle against terrorism," National Security expert Mark Zaid said on the same podcast. "But the priorities aren't straight and now as we face real threats from outside of the U.S., we've got Stephen Miller trying to round up day laborers."
Trump's actions, have of course, sparked a lot of condemnation for not seeking Congressional approval, but the truth is no president has sought Congressional approval since World War II before taking isolated military action.
The bigger question is, "why now?" Why did Donald Trump give the Iranian regime two weeks to come to the table while apparently already planning to attack them before the end of those two weeks?
Speculation is running wild on that one, from presidential impatience, to Bibi or even Vladimir Putin pulling Trump's strings (or pissing him off, as Putin and his inner circle, allies of Iran, have torn into Trump for the attack. To which, predictably, Trump responded with a Tweet (or Truth, or whatever that's called).
But at the end of the day, members of the Trump administration said the ball is now firmly in Iran's court. That is exactly the point.
**It 's how Iran returns the ball that should have everyone concerned**. Regime change is a possibility, but so is increased Iranian support for the oppressive regime for the simple fact that the country was attacked by the United States.
Thus, we could be staring at terroristic threats (a suicide church bombing in Syria on Sunday could be the opening act), higher gas prices, drone and missile strikes on American troops in Iraq and Europe or some un-wonderful combination of all of the above.
Donald Trump has been flying by the seat of his pants his whole life, rarely making plans and blustering his way through every situation he faces with an arrogant ego and the belief that he can take whatever occurs and make it work for him.
If he's wrong, then he's gambling on more than just an isolated bombing--and much more than the Trump Taj Mahal or Trump Ties.
**He 's ultimately gambling with everyone's life** - and much of his MAGA support appears to be splintering, as some of his worshippers are only now beginning to face up to this unpleasant fact.

Peter,

You may be wondering why radical liberals like Colin Allred and Beto O’Rourke are once again sniffing around Texas politics after years of humiliating defeats.

"**Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada make changes to lure business amid Delaware 's 'Dexit' concern,**" AP's **Mingson Lau** - "Lawmakers in Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada have recently approved changes aimed at helping their states dip into the lucrative side of corporate litigation that Delaware, with a specialized court and business-friendly laws, has dominated as the world's incorporation capital.

Concerned that these changes may lure corporations away from Delaware, thereby causing the small state to lose millions in corporate franchise taxes, Delaware officials have responded with their own changes to solidify their status in the business world.

In Texas, which opened a business court last year, there was bipartisan support for legislation diminishing shareholder powers and giving businesses more legal protections against shareholder lawsuits. Nevada lawmakers approved a corporation-friendly update to its business laws, also with bipartisan support, and separately moved toward asking voters to consider changing the state constitution to create a dedicated business court with appointed judges.

Billionaire **Elon Musk** had advocated both states as better options for incorporation after a [Delaware judge struck down](https://substack.com/redirect/4fb2c8de-9863-45de-a289-104c8df9e4d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his shareholder-approved $56 billion compensation package from Tesla. Musk's businesses have also changed where they're incorporated: [Tesla and SpaceX relocated to Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/17136a3a-1134-4c45-9587-8104a9c4a15e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while [Neuralink moved to Nevada](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3d5834-70d5-4cba-b2fb-3a1a98c92fed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Oklahoma also took action to get in the mix, as the Republican-led Legislature sanctioned the creation of business courts in its two most populous counties, a move the governor said would help Oklahoma become the most business-friendly state.

"This is an area in which states, in many ways, are behaving like businesses," said **Robert Ahdieh** , dean of the Texas A&M University School of Law. "Delaware is selling something. Texas is selling something that they hold out to be better. So it is very much a comparative exercise." ...
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/24a90872-cd19-4115-9860-692a6013867a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In May, Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors.

Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas' implementation imposes a "far higher barrier than the norm," Ahdieh said.

Consumer advocates worry the changes endanger shareholder and investor protections by giving owners and directors more protection against lawsuits that could hold them accountable if they violate their fiduciary duty.

TOP NEWS "Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada make changes to lure business amid Delaware 's 'Dexit' concern," AP's Mingson Lau - "Lawmakers in Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada have recently approved changes aimed at helping their states dip into the lucrative side of corporate litigation that Delaware, with a specialized court and business-friendly laws, has dominated as the world's incorporation capital. Concerned that these changes may lure corporations away from Delaware, thereby causing the small state to lose millions in corporate franchise taxes, Delaware officials have responded with their own changes to solidify their status in the business world. In Texas, which opened a business court last year, there was bipartisan support for legislation diminishing shareholder powers and giving businesses more legal protections against shareholder lawsuits. Nevada lawmakers approved a corporation-friendly update to its business laws, also with bipartisan support, and separately moved toward asking voters to consider changing the state constitution to create a dedicated business court with appointed judges. Billionaire Elon Musk had advocated both states as better options for incorporation after a his shareholder-approved $56 billion compensation package from Tesla. Musk's businesses have also changed where they're incorporated: , while . Oklahoma also took action to get in the mix, as the Republican-led Legislature sanctioned the creation of business courts in its two most populous counties, a move the governor said would help Oklahoma become the most business-friendly state. "This is an area in which states, in many ways, are behaving like businesses," said Robert Ahdieh , dean of the Texas A&M University School of Law. "Delaware is selling something. Texas is selling something that they hold out to be better. So it is very much a comparative exercise." ... In May, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors. Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas' implementation imposes a "far higher barrier than the norm," Ahdieh said. Consumer advocates worry the changes endanger shareholder and investor protections by giving owners and directors more protection against lawsuits that could hold them accountable if they violate their fiduciary duty. For businesses, the changes mean potentially saving millions of dollars in shareholder lawsuit settlements and legal fees by mitigating the likelihood of those costly cases reaching court. For the states, attracting the companies means millions in business activity and revenue from regulatory filing and court case fees and taxes." # [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1679%2E791427%2E5K5ERv)

Friend — When Republican Rep. Thomas Massie introduced a resolution last week that would block Donald Trump from going to war with Iran, I was one of the first members of the House to sign on.
**That’s because Americans on both sides of the aisle strongly oppose the prospect of more needless, endless wars in the Middle East.**
But that wasn’t always the case.
For a long time, people like me have paid a political price for advocating for peace, diplomacy, and justice as the path forward for US foreign policy.
The entire establishment supported the Iraq War back in the early 2000s. Politicians and media figures across the spectrum believed the lie that Iraq had weapons of mass destruction. And as a result, thousands of Americans and hundreds of thousands of Iraqi civilians lost their lives.
But now the American people can see the damage caused by US military intervention. They understand that nobody wins when we use violence and force to destabilize people and communities around the world, and that includes Iran.
In fact, a recent poll showed that only **16% of Americans** support US military intervention in Iran.
Friend, I have always forcefully spoken against — and voted against — war and bloodshed, from Iraq, to Gaza, to Ukraine, and now in Iran. I am asking you to support me today and help me show that there is a political price to pay for _supporting_ needless wars, not opposing them.
**[Please, chip in to my campaign today and help us continue to drive forward our pro-peace, anti-war movement. * **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada make changes to lure business amid Delaware 's 'Dexit' concern,**" AP's **Mingson Lau** - "Lawmakers in Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada have recently approved changes aimed at helping their states dip into the lucrative side of corporate litigation that Delaware, with a specialized court and business-friendly laws, has dominated as the world's incorporation capital.

Concerned that these changes may lure corporations away from Delaware, thereby causing the small state to lose millions in corporate franchise taxes, Delaware officials have responded with their own changes to solidify their status in the business world.

In Texas, which opened a business court last year, there was bipartisan support for legislation diminishing shareholder powers and giving businesses more legal protections against shareholder lawsuits. Nevada lawmakers approved a corporation-friendly update to its business laws, also with bipartisan support, and separately moved toward asking voters to consider changing the state constitution to create a dedicated business court with appointed judges.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/355a6e48-18cc-4497-b597-ca49632b0e0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Billionaire **Elon Musk** had advocated both states as better options for incorporation after a [Delaware judge struck down](https://substack.com/redirect/3a7a4d52-29ab-4112-a908-e1a543c38895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his shareholder-approved $56 billion compensation package from Tesla. Musk's businesses have also changed where they're incorporated: [Tesla and SpaceX relocated to Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab5989c-304c-441c-9336-75e517beaa44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while [Neuralink moved to Nevada](https://substack.com/redirect/0e4cea92-b89a-4b00-86a1-4a483afacfe2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Oklahoma also took action to get in the mix, as the Republican-led Legislature sanctioned the creation of business courts in its two most populous counties, a move the governor said would help Oklahoma become the most business-friendly state.

"This is an area in which states, in many ways, are behaving like businesses," said **Robert Ahdieh** , dean of the Texas A&M University School of Law. "Delaware is selling something. Texas is selling something that they hold out to be better. So it is very much a comparative exercise." ...
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/355a6e48-18cc-4497-b597-ca49632b0e0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In May, Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors.

Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas' implementation imposes a "far higher barrier than the norm," Ahdieh said.

Consumer advocates worry the changes endanger shareholder and investor protections by giving owners and directors more protection against lawsuits that could hold them accountable if they violate their fiduciary duty.

For businesses, the changes mean potentially saving millions of dollars in shareholder lawsuit settlements and legal fees by mitigating the likelihood of those costly cases reaching court. For the states, attracting the companies means millions in business activity and revenue from regulatory filing and court case fees and taxes." TOP NEWS "Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada make changes to lure business amid Delaware 's 'Dexit' concern," AP's Mingson Lau - "Lawmakers in Texas, Oklahoma and Nevada have recently approved changes aimed at helping their states dip into the lucrative side of corporate litigation that Delaware, with a specialized court and business-friendly laws, has dominated as the world's incorporation capital. Concerned that these changes may lure corporations away from Delaware, thereby causing the small state to lose millions in corporate franchise taxes, Delaware officials have responded with their own changes to solidify their status in the business world. In Texas, which opened a business court last year, there was bipartisan support for legislation diminishing shareholder powers and giving businesses more legal protections against shareholder lawsuits. Nevada lawmakers approved a corporation-friendly update to its business laws, also with bipartisan support, and separately moved toward asking voters to consider changing the state constitution to create a dedicated business court with appointed judges. Billionaire Elon Musk had advocated both states as better options for incorporation after a his shareholder-approved $56 billion compensation package from Tesla. Musk's businesses have also changed where they're incorporated: , while . Oklahoma also took action to get in the mix, as the Republican-led Legislature sanctioned the creation of business courts in its two most populous counties, a move the governor said would help Oklahoma become the most business-friendly state. "This is an area in which states, in many ways, are behaving like businesses," said Robert Ahdieh , dean of the Texas A&M University School of Law. "Delaware is selling something. Texas is selling something that they hold out to be better. So it is very much a comparative exercise." ... In May, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors. Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas' implementation imposes a "far higher barrier than the norm," Ahdieh said. Consumer advocates worry the changes endanger shareholder and investor protections by giving owners and directors more protection against lawsuits that could hold them accountable if they violate their fiduciary duty. For businesses, the changes mean potentially saving millions of dollars in shareholder lawsuit settlements and legal fees by mitigating the likelihood of those costly cases reaching court. For the states, attracting the companies means millions in business activity and revenue from regulatory filing and court case fees and taxes." In May, Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors.

Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas’ implementation imposes a “far higher barrier than the norm,” Ahdieh said.

Concerned that these changes may lure corporations away from Delaware, thereby causing the small state to lose millions in corporate franchise taxes, Delaware officials have responded with their own changes to solidify their status in the business world. In Texas, which opened a business court last year, there was bipartisan support for legislation diminishing shareholder powers and giving businesses more legal protections against shareholder lawsuits. Nevada lawmakers approved a corporation-friendly update to its business laws, also with bipartisan support, and separately moved toward asking voters to consider changing the state constitution to create a dedicated business court with appointed judges. » Billionaire Elon Musk had advocated both states as better options for incorporation after a his shareholder-approved $56 billion compensation package from Tesla. Texas is selling something that they hold out to be better. So it is very much a comparative exercise.” ... » In May, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott signed legislation providing greater securities for corporate officers and adding restrictions to shareholder records requests. The bill also allows corporations to require an ownership threshold, no more than 3% in outstanding shares, before a shareholder can initiate a derivative lawsuit, typically on behalf of the company and against its own board or directors. Restrictions on who can initiate such lawsuits are not uncommon, but Texas’ implementation imposes a “far higher barrier than the norm,” Ahdieh said. Consumer advocates worry the changes endanger shareholder and investor protections by giving owners and directors more protection against lawsuits that could hold them accountable if they violate their fiduciary duty. name: Ayanna Pressley
subject: Three years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250624-1392-foote&t=1001&akid=1392%2E342411%2E_ejjar ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

In a couple of days, my daughter, Cora, will turn 17. As we're looking at
colleges, one key factor that shapes that decision is where she'll be able
to access healthcare.

That's now a part of our calculus and our decision-making three years
after the Supreme Court denied our bodily autonomy and ripped away the
basic right to abortion care in America.

Since that cruel decision, we have witnessed devastating and deadly
consequences for patients across the nation.

Abortion bans are denying families basic medical care.

The Black maternal health crisis has worsened drastically.

Republicans’ attacks on our basic reproductive freedom are a risk to every
person who calls this country home and have disproportionately impacted
our Black, brown, immigrant, disabled, and LGBTQ+ communities.

But here’s what they didn’t count on: us.

This unjust and worsening status quo is not an inevitability. From the
halls of Congress to grassroots movements across the country, we’re
building the power to fight back.

We will not only fight to protect and defend reproductive care, but also
to advance an affirmative vision for a just America where abortion justice
is realized and everyone—no matter their zip code, income, or immigration
status—can access the care they need with dignity in their own community.

As Chair of the Reproductive Freedom Caucus, I’m standing shoulder to
shoulder with Alexandria, Ilhan, Rashida and our movement to champion
reproductive rights.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250624-movement.LDeb_G&refcode=em20250624-1392&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1392%2E342411%2E_ejjar ]But this is a fight we can only win together. Will you chip in
$3 or more today to help power our work and grow this
movement for reproductive freedom?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250624-movement.LDeb_G&refcode=em20250624-1392&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1392%2E342411%2E_ejjar ]Contribute ››

We know this fight won’t be won in a single moment or with a single bill —
it will take organizing, persistence, and collective action. We are in
this fight for the long haul.

In solidarity,

Ayanna

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A longer, but important, note from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
A few thoughts from me about what this moment in our nation’s history means.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2576%2E4032634%2EbyXF6_)
---
This is a longer note from me, but it’s incredibly important — and I hope you read it. I’m not going to sugarcoat this: It’s really tough out there right now. This is a moment where we have seen the President of the United States violate the Constitution and bomb Iran — without Congressional approval, and without a long-term plan for our service members, the people in the region, or for stability and peace. This is a moment where we have seen the President of the United States turn the National Guard and Marines against civilian protesters out in Los Angeles, a moment when people are being snatched off the streets by ICE, snatched by people who are wearing masks, who don't identify themselves, who stuff people into unmarked vans, who bust out car windshields, who hang out at elementary schools trying to snag people in. This is a moment where the budget cuts in Washington are aimed at our education system, at cancer research, at ALS research, at climate research — at so many of the things that give us brighter futures. **Put plainly: This is a moment where the President of the United States is the most openly corrupt human being to serve that office.** And where are the Republicans in Congress? I've just got to say, they seem to be suffering a major medical emergency. They have had their spines removed. Evidently, the only movement they are physically capable of at this moment is bowing down to the great Donald Trump. What also makes this moment tough is simply not having as much power as we want. And we don’t right now — not in the House, not in the Senate, and obviously not in the White House. But that is not the same as having no power at all. We need to use what we’ve got, and I’m here to remind everyone that that still matters. **Let’s take Social Security for example.** Donald Trump, JD Vance, and Elon Musk lied about identifying fraud and abuse in the Social Security program. They worked to fire the people who work at the SSA, shut down the phone services, and shut down the offices. So I started a Social Security War Room. We got people organized, we got the information, we got the data, we worked to get the story out. And right now the phones are still operating, the offices are still open, and not as many people have been fired from the agency as DOGE wanted. Right now Social Security is still functioning, and functioning the way it should. It's not fancy, it's not a headline, it's not setting off fireworks, but by God, it's standing up for a government that works for all of us. We did something. And that matters. **We’re taking that same energy to the legislative fight with Trump’s Big Ugly Bill.** This is the bill that would cut access to health care for over 16 million people, take away food support, cut a lot of our clean energy programs that keep our energy bills low — all so that a handful of billionaires can get even fancier handouts from the federal government. The GOP might have their majorities right now, but that doesn’t mean that we just accept defeat on this. I’ve been encouraging supporters across the country to make calls to their senators. We’ve already secured some wins in the reconciliation process, like taking out the provision that would completely wipe out funding for the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. I’m trying to get Republicans on the record, asking them if they really believe that babies should lose their health care so that Jeff Bezos can buy the third yacht, and if people should be pushed out of a nursing home so that Elon Musk can take a rocket ship ride to Mars. What can you do? You’ve got to remember you can make a difference. [**The very number one thing you can do is tell your stories.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-medicaidstory/?source=EMZ26J_GOP_E_20250624_V1S1&t=8&akid=2576%2E4032634%2EbyXF6_) It’s powerful. When Trump announced that he was going to cut the Department of Education, many of you sent in your stories about what public school meant to you, what it means to someone you love, why it matters. I read some of those stories down on the floor of the Senate. We shared some of them with the press. I also got the Secretary of Education to come in and talk with me, and as she got ready to leave, I handed her a stack of more than a thousand stories and asked her to read what public education means to people all across this country. I also got her to admit in that meeting that no, she does not have legal authority to dismantle the Department of Education, and it may just matter in the pending lawsuit right now that the Secretary has said that. The second thing I ask you to do is organize. Organize, organize, organize. You know, one voice is loud when you speak up, two voices are twice as loud, and it goes from there. Check out [**Indivisible**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3036?t=9&akid=2576%2E4032634%2EbyXF6_). Check out [**EMILY’s List**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3037?t=10&akid=2576%2E4032634%2EbyXF6_). Join a group, because that makes us stronger. And then the third thing: I want to remind everyone to take care in this moment. We're in this for the long haul. We're not going to fix this in an hour. We're not going to even be able to fix it in a day or a week, and that means you’ve got to have some ways that you take care of yourself. I’ve got Bruce and [**Bailey**](https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP08/1/87932/images/D5fY8jiWwAAAv28.jpeg) by my side. And I know I’ve got this grassroots team, too.

Whatever it is for you, take some time, because we have so much on the line, and we have to be strong. To say it another way: **We must persist.** More from me soon. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

# "MAKE MY DAY!" Trump calls out AOC in BRUTAL Truth Social takedown
**[President Donald Trump destroyed AOC](https://substack.com/redirect/dae1563b-0363-4a44-b2f4-07d4f2b48aeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Truth Social after she publicly suggested a third impeachment attempt following U.S. military strikes on Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dae1563b-0363-4a44-b2f4-07d4f2b48aeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump DARES Democrats to impeach him again:** On Truth Social, he urged congressional Democrats to initiate a third impeachment, defiantly quoting "Go ahead ... MAKE MY DAY!" in response to their criticism of recent successful U.S. airstrikes on Iran.
* **Targets progressive lawmakers by name:** He specifically criticized Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, calling her "one of the 'dumbest' people in Congress", as well as Reps. Jasmine Crockett and Rep. Ilhan Omar, questioning their intelligence and patriotism.
* **AOC 's response:** In **[an X post response](https://substack.com/redirect/6e775baa-1270-4729-86ef-11eb3388bb9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , AOC joked, "Mr. President, don't take your anger out on me - I'm just a silly girl" before accusing Trump of illegal decision-making aimed "to betray the American people."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e775baa-1270-4729-86ef-11eb3388bb9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

# 11 illegal Iranian immigrants with terrorist ties arrested by I.C.E
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bd3ed9c4-b217-4945-b22e-f0a4706fd26c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Immigration officials nabbed **[11 illegal immigrants with previous records and suspected terrorist ties](https://substack.com/redirect/bd3ed9c4-b217-4945-b22e-f0a4706fd26c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** let in by the Biden administration over the past weekend.
* **ICE arrested 11 Iranian migrants in eight U.S. states over the weekend** --including individuals with suspected terrorism-related affiliations. "We don't wait until a military operation to execute; we proactively deliver on President Trump's mandate to secure the homeland," The DHS said.
* **Notable detainees include a former IRGC member linked to Iran-backed terrorist group** Hezbollah in Minnesota, a watch-listed individual in Mississippi, and a former Iranian sniper arrested in Alabama with military ID.
* **Five detainees have prior criminal records** , with convictions ranging from grand larceny to drug and weapon offenses.
* **Border Patrol memo warns of potential Iranian "sleeper cells"** , citing over 700 illegal Iranian migrants under the Biden administration and urging heightened agent vigilance post-U.S. strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities.

* * *
# Trump nominated for Nobel Peace Prize for Iran ceasefire deal
Rep. Buddy Carter (R-Ga.) **[formally nominated President Donald Trump for the Nobel Peace Prize](https://substack.com/redirect/b968d8f4-d79e-4401-9409-d362c5f96b9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Tuesday, citing his "extraordinary and historic role in brokering an end to the armed conflict between Israel and Iran" and preventing the world's largest state sponsor of terrorism from obtaining nuclear weapons.
* **Cease-Fire Achievement:** The nomination comes after Trump announced a cease-fire between Iran and Israel on Monday evening, proposing to call it the "12 Day War," just two days after ordering an unprecedented U.S. attack on three Iranian nuclear sites in support of Israeli strikes. Carter praised Trump's "swift agreement that many believed to be impossible" in a region of "historical animosity and political volatility."
* **Trump's Expectations:** Despite the nomination, Trump has made clear he doesn't expect to win, writing on Truth Social that "I won't get a Nobel Peace Prize no matter what I do," referencing his role in brokering peace deals between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, stopping conflicts between India-Pakistan and Serbia-Kosovo, and his 2020 Abraham Accords that established diplomatic relations between Israel and four Arab nations.

Five detainees have prior criminal records , with convictions ranging from grand larceny to drug and weapon offenses. Border Patrol memo warns of potential Iranian "sleeper cells" , citing over 700 illegal Iranian migrants under the Biden administration and urging heightened agent vigilance post-U.S. strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities. Trump nominated for Nobel Peace Prize for Iran ceasefire deal Rep. Buddy Carter (R-Ga.) on Tuesday, citing his "extraordinary and historic role in brokering an end to the armed conflict between Israel and Iran" and preventing the world's largest state sponsor of terrorism from obtaining nuclear weapons. Cease-Fire Achievement: The nomination comes after Trump announced a cease-fire between Iran and Israel on Monday evening, proposing to call it the "12 Day War," just two days after ordering an unprecedented U.S. attack on three Iranian nuclear sites in support of Israeli strikes. Carter praised Trump's "swift agreement that many believed to be impossible" in a region of "historical animosity and political volatility." Trump's Expectations: Despite the nomination, Trump has made clear he doesn't expect to win, writing on Truth Social that "I won't get a Nobel Peace Prize no matter what I do," referencing his role in brokering peace deals between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, stopping conflicts between India-Pakistan and Serbia-Kosovo, and his 2020 Abraham Accords that established diplomatic relations between Israel and four Arab nations. | | POLL Should Trump get the Nobel Peace Prize for brokering the ceasefire? | ? ? ? * PolitiBrawl is a reader-supported publication. Three years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, ending the federal right to abortion.

**We knew what was at stake. We knew it wasn’t going to stop there. And today, our worst fears are coming true.**

subject: The Democratic establishment is attacking the future of the Party

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Democratic Party leaders and gatekeepers continue to self-sabotage and
fail to learn from their mistakes.

Just look at Welcomefest, the tone-deaf corporate conference which
Politico called the “moderate Democrats’ Coachella.”

While Donald Trump and the MAGA crowd rapidly move our country closer to
fascism, corporate stooges of Congress gathered to commiserate over the
2024 election and double down on their insistence to attack progressive
candidates and marginalized groups instead of the very billionaire donors
and corporate Super PACs that brought us a Republican trifecta—and funded
“Welcomefest.”

Then, take a look at what’s happening in New York City. Once a young
Democratic socialist candidate started surging in the polls for mayor —
with the promise of actually energizing disaffected and disillusioned
voters — billionaires, super PACs, and old-guard Democrats such as Bill
Clinton, George Latimer, and Rep. Jim Clyburn came out of the woodwork to
support disgraced, corrupt former Governor Andrew Cuomo.

What does it say that the Democratic establishment would rather support a
candidate accused of sexual misconduct by 13 women than a promising
progressive like Zohran Mamdani?

Zohran — a candidate that could serve as the solution to so many of the
Democratic Party’s woes — is served to the political establishment on a
silver platter, and instead of harnessing that energy, they unite to
oppose a better future for everyday people on behalf of their corporate
donors.

When candidates are brave and actually offer solutions that improve the
lives of working people while standing up to the political establishment,
billionaires, and their Super PACs, we can go up against even the greatest
odds and the most entrenched career politicians.

The Democratic Party needs to wake up, clean house, and let the next
generation of young, working-class progressives lead the way if we’re
going to give voters a party to believe in and start winning elections
again.

As for our work in Congress – if any Democrat is unwilling to change and
meet the moment, then they should get the hell out of the way or face a
potential primary challenge come 2026.

representative Donavan McKinney in Michigan’s 13th district — to run

In this episode of _Endless Urgency Live_ , Democratic strategist **Mike Nellis** sits down with **Sarah Stewart-Holland** , co-host of the acclaimed _Pantsuit Politics_ podcast, for a wide-ranging, honest, and deeply human conversation.
They dive into:
* The latest **U.S. military action in Iran** and what it means for American foreign policy and global stability.
* The **New York City mayor 's race**, featuring Andrew Cuomo's attempted comeback and Zohran Mamdani's incredible rise.
* How to stay politically engaged **without losing your mind** , and why being a "joyful warrior" still matters in the fight for a better world.
* Travel stories from **Italy and the Vatican** , building the habit of looking for **good news** , and how _Pantsuit Politics_ is helping listeners process the news with less anxiety and more agency.

Whether you're a political junkie, a burned-out Democrat, or someone just trying to understand what the hell is happening, this episode offers **smart, grounded insights with a side of humor, history, and hope**.
🔹 Listen now to hear why Mike won't rank Cuomo, what radicalized Sarah into politics, and how both are thinking about _health care reform_ , _Democratic leadership_ , and what comes next for Democrats after Joe Biden.

President Trump brokers a historic ceasefire between Israel and Iran. Although the agreement was made, Israel still chose to drop bombs on Iran before the 12 hour window closed. This put the deal on shaky legs and President Trump rebuked both Iran and Israel for the attack after the deal had been done. Iran has upset Qatar and other neighbors, so their options are running thin. Today Dr. Seb Gorka takes us inside the White House to get a play by play of how things went down. Operation Midnight Hammer was Top Gun Maverick on steroids, as B-2 bombers dropped 12 bunker buster bombs on Iran's nuclear sites. Even as the online community went up in arms, just days later, President Trump brought a peace deal, showing that he is not a forever war president. In case you haven't been paying attention, the attack on Fordow sends a message to regimes and dictators. President Trump will deliver overwhelming precision force to protect Americans and American interests, just like he did when he took out Sulemani and the chemical weapons plant in Syria. Chad Robichaux, a former Force Recon Marine, takes us inside the mission planning, the brilliance and sophisticated execution for the joint forces. The leadership of President Trump and Pete Hegseth is inspiring young men and women around the country. As Hegseth has brought back the warrior ethos, U.S. military recruiting is at a high. Chad unpacks and sleeper cells that may be activated inside the U.S. and how you and your loved ones can stay prepared.

| | _Trigger Warning: Mentions of Abortion, Maternal Mortality, and Death_ Hey team, Three years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and ended the constitutional right to have an abortion in their _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_ decision. Since then, we’ve seen a rise of fear and confusion amongst our communities — but beyond that, a rise of state-level rollbacks on reproductive freedom and abortion access led by far-right extremists. **Right here in Georgia, this issue hits home.** We’ve collectively mourned two preventable deaths of our fellow Georgians. We continue to bear witness to unnecessary trauma and hurt community members. We watched as Governor Brian Kemp rushed to pass what he bragged was “the toughest abortion bill in the country.” In September 2024, a ProPublica report revealed that at least two women in Georgia lost their lives after being denied critical reproductive care due to Governor Kemp's extreme abortion ban — _that same report warned that more deaths were likely to follow. _ In February 2025, Adriana Smith, a pregnant 30-year-old nurse, was declared brain dead and was put on life support at Emory University Hospital. Although her family intended to keep her on life support until the baby was born, Governor Kemp’s restrictions still denied them the reasonable freedom and ability to make critical medical decisions on her behalf. Thankfully, Adriana’s son was delivered by emergency C-section on June 13th, and remains in the NICU. Adriana will be laid to rest at the end of this month, and her family is asking for continued prayers for Adriana’s baby boy. **Instead of focusing on Georgia’s health care crisis, Governor Kemp continuously chooses to advance an extremist agenda that is harmful to our communities across the state. ** Under Governor Kemp’s leadership, Georgia has some of the worst Black maternal mortality rates in the entire country. We have extreme doctor and nurse shortages and are faced with hospital closures across the state. To top it off — almost half a million Georgians lack access to basic health care because of Governor Kemp’s refusal to expand Medicaid. **If we’ve learned anything since the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , it’s that we cannot rely on the courts to protect our most fundamental freedoms, and we most certainly cannot count on far-right officials like Kemp or the Trump Regime to protect our communities.** While we continue the work of protecting the right to vote and supporting pro-reproductive freedom and pro-democracy candidates, Fair Fight has and always will continue to uplift and support pro-democracy leaders and organizations in Georgia and across the South seeking to defend reproductive justice and educate our most vulnerable communities. In solidarity,

clean_body: Restricting abortion access and reproductive freedom was never going to have positive outcomes. | | | Trigger Warning: Mentions of Abortion, Maternal Mortality, and Death Hey team, Three years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and ended the constitutional right to have an abortion in their Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization decision. Since then, we’ve seen a rise of fear and confusion amongst our communities — but beyond that, a rise of state-level rollbacks on reproductive freedom and abortion access led by far-right extremists. Right here in Georgia, this issue hits home. We’ve collectively mourned two preventable deaths of our fellow Georgians. We continue to bear witness to unnecessary trauma and hurt community members. We watched as Governor Brian Kemp rushed to pass what he bragged was “the toughest abortion bill in the country.” In September 2024, a ProPublica report revealed that at least two women in Georgia lost their lives after being denied critical reproductive care due to Governor Kemp's extreme abortion ban — that same report warned that more deaths were likely to follow. In February 2025, Adriana Smith, a pregnant 30-year-old nurse, was declared brain dead and was put on life support at Emory University Hospital. Although her family intended to keep her on life support until the baby was born, Governor Kemp’s restrictions still denied them the reasonable freedom and ability to make critical medical decisions on her behalf. Thankfully, Adriana’s son was delivered by emergency C-section on June 13th, and remains in the NICU. Adriana will be laid to rest at the end of this month, and her family is asking for continued prayers for Adriana’s baby boy. Instead of focusing on Georgia’s health care crisis, Governor Kemp continuously chooses to advance an extremist agenda that is harmful to our communities across the state. Under Governor Kemp’s leadership, Georgia has some of the worst Black maternal mortality rates in the entire country. We have extreme doctor and nurse shortages and are faced with hospital closures across the state. To top it off — almost half a million Georgians lack access to basic health care because of Governor Kemp’s refusal to expand Medicaid. If we’ve learned anything since the overturning of Roe v. Wade , it’s that we cannot rely on the courts to protect our most fundamental freedoms, and we most certainly cannot count on far-right officials like Kemp or the Trump Regime to protect our communities. While we continue the work of protecting the right to vote and supporting pro-reproductive freedom and pro-democracy candidates, Fair Fight has and always will continue to uplift and support pro-democracy leaders and organizations in Georgia and across the South seeking to defend reproductive justice and educate our most vulnerable communities. Friend, there is so much that this little girl couldn't have imagined – like becoming one of the first women to represent Nevada in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110182634/553538638/1086012512?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5546-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNWQ3ZjVmNi00NzUxLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vLgtgPZCz1Qr132scqzz1nXJCWM4NpItfXQElWVotEQ=)
She especially never could have imagined that when she was all grown-up, she would be fighting to stop Republican extremists from taking away her most fundamental rights.

**It’s been three years since the Supreme Court overturned** _**Roe v. Wade,**_** ending women's constitutional right to abortion – and with it, our right to make extremely personal decisions about our bodies, our health care, and our own families.**

Now, the Trump administration has pushed forward a policy that can allow doctors to be punished for providing lifesaving reproductive care.
It breaks my heart to know that future generations will be growing up with fewer rights than the generations that came before. That's why I'm fighting back every day to protect and restore reproductive freedom nationwide.
I helped introduce the Right to Contraception Act in the Senate to protect the right to access birth control – and the Let Doctors Provide Reproductive Health Care Act to protect the right of medical professionals to provide often-lifesaving reproductive care. And just this month, I also joined Senate Democrats in introducing the Protect IVF Act.
But, friend: What will truly determine the future of all our efforts to protect women’s rights and reproductive freedom is the fight for Senate control – and our ability to win depends on supporters like you.
**On the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade, _****my team and I have set a goal to raise $10,000, and I'm counting on your help to reach it before midnight.**

Three years ago on this very day, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v.
Wade.

And our country hasn’t been the same since,
Derek.

The far-right, activist Supreme Court, with 5 justices appointed by
presidents who lost the popular vote in the United States, overturned 50
years of precedent and ripped away a fundamental freedom from millions of
Americans.

I’m still so alarmed at the danger this decision created for millions of
women and families.

Across the country, states have issued total and near-total abortion bans.
Far-right judges have come after medication abortion, in-vitro
fertilization, contraception, and doctors who provide women with
reproductive health care.

And Donald Trump continues to double down on his anti-abortion stance.
He’s gloated about the undoing of Roe under his administration. He’s
filled his Cabinet and administration with anti-abortion activists. Not to
mention who he would nominate if he gets a Supreme Court vacancy. And they
will stop at nothing to control women’s healthcare decisions.

Derek, I ran for
Senate to stop the dangerous Trump agenda and put some checks on a radical
Supreme Court hellbent on forcing a social agenda on a country that does
not want it.

Here are some ways we can stand up to these extreme right-wing assaults on
our freedoms — and we must. Here is what we must do when we retake the
majority in the Senate:

➡️ Expand our Supreme Court: Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump stacked the
Supreme Court, and unless we want an entire generation to suffer, we must
unstack it.

➡️ Impose term limits on the Court.

➡️ Pass an enforceable code of ethics in the court.

➡️ Codify abortion and reproductive health care rights once and for all.
